jobs.description:
**Materya \| Beverly Hills, CA \| In\-Person**  
Part\-Time, 20–30 hrs/week \| 1099 Independent Contractor  
$30–45/hour, based on experience

**About Materya**

Materya is a high\-end boutique kitchen and bath showroom in the heart of Beverly Hills, specializing in renowned Italian design, exceptional materials, and beautifully considered spaces.

We believe great design requires creativity, precision, and exceptional client service. Behind every successful project is a team that is organized, responsive, and committed to getting the details right. Our environment is fast\-paced, and we value professionalism, accountability, clear communication, and people who take pride in their work.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly organized and detail\-oriented Bookkeeper \& Project Coordinator to support the financial and operational side of our business.

This is a hands\-on role combining bookkeeping, scheduling, and project coordination. You’ll manage day\-to\-day financial tasks, coordinate project logistics, and work closely with our accounting office and internal team to keep everything accurate and on schedule.

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-paced environment, knows how to prioritize, and can confidently manage multiple moving pieces without losing sight of the details.

**What You'll Do**

* Manage day\-to\-day bookkeeping in QuickBooks
* Complete weekly and monthly reconciliations with our accounting office
* Prepare and send invoices and statements and assist with payment collection
* Maintain calendars for client meetings, deliveries, installations, and shipping
* Coordinate deliveries and shipping schedules
* Communicate with our accounting office, vendors, and internal team
* Track open items and follow up to keep projects moving
* Support the smooth day\-to\-day operations of the showroom

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong working knowledge of QuickBooks and Excel
* Bookkeeping experience, including account reconciliation
* Exceptional organization and attention to detail
* Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Clear, professional, and proactive communicator
* Self\-motivated, reliable, and able to work independently
* Strong follow\-through and a sense of ownership
* Comfortable working in a high\-end, design\-focused environment

**Compensation**

* $30–45/hour, based on experience
* Part\-time, approximately 20–30 hours/week
* 1099 Independent Contractor
* In\-person at our Beverly Hills showroom

**Join Materya**

If you’re organized, proactive, and enjoy being the person who keeps things accurate, on track, and moving forward, we’d love to hear from you.

Join a boutique team where your work is valued, your attention to detail matters, and you’ll play an important role in supporting the business behind beautiful design.

Pay: $30\.00 \- $45\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Account Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job**
-------


Account Coordinator**Description**
---------------

**POSITION TITLE: Account Coordinator**


Deluxe Media Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Platinum Equity, is a global leader in media and entertainment services for film, video, and online content. Since 1915, Deluxe has been the trusted partner for the world’s most successful Hollywood studios, independent film companies, TV networks, exhibitors, advertisers, and others, offering best\-in\-class solutions in post\-production, distribution, asset and workflow management, and cloud\-based technologies.


With headquarters in Los Angeles and offices around the globe, the company employs over 3,200 of the most talented artists, developers, and industry veterans worldwide. For more information, please visit www.bydeluxe.com.


We currently have an opening for **Account Coordinator.** The position will be a hybrid role in Burbank, CA.

**ABOUT THE ROLE:** As a Account Coordinator, you will be responsible for monitoring and evaluating day\-to\-day order management, overseeing order processing, and other client\-specific operations. With a strong focus on attention to detail and collaboration, you will respond effectively to unforeseen challenges and ensure operational processes run smoothly. If you're passionate about the entertainment industry and thrive in a fast\-paced, multi\-tasking environment, we want to hear from you.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Monitor and evaluate day\-to\-day order\-management tasks related to title releases.
* Manage order queue and responsible for timely order processing.
* Create and distribute secure access to theatrical engagements through KDM processing.
* Create and analyze reports to ensure orders are processed accurately and efficiently.
* Respond effectively to unforeseen challenges and ensure operational processes aren't hindered in the face of evolving circumstances.
* Creation of work orders and bookings in proprietary workflow system.
* Review and schedule work orders and projects to adhere with client SLA’s and operational capacities.
* Email management and effective communication with internal and external partners. Maintain professional and positive working relationships with internal studio representatives to maintain information flow.
* Knowledge and understanding of multiple client needs and workflow nuances.
* Lead and adhere to workflows and procedures and remain up to date with changes.
* May be requested to work additional or off hours due to flux in business or client needs.
* Special projects/other duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Collaborative team player with strong focus on teamwork.
* Proficient in managing information across diverse tech platforms.
* Reliable, flexible and skilled at multi\-tasking, work effectively under pressure and possess strong organizational and interpersonal skills.
* Proficient in word processing, spreadsheets, inventory, order processing, project management, and database software's.
* Strong analytical skills to solve problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations.
* High attention to detail.
* Efficient in managing time and tasks effectively.
* Strong desire for continued learning.
* Positive attitude with the ability to remain professional in high stress situations.
* Solid technical understanding of the post\-production industry a plus.


If you're an independent thinker with a high level of ingenuity and the above qualifications, then we'd like you to join our team!


We offer a competitive salary and benefits, including 401(k).

**Diversity Statement:**


Deluxe is committed to inclusivity, fostering an environment where every employee feels comfortable bringing their full selves to work. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, and will not be discriminated against, on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, sex, age, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state or local laws, regulations or ordinances. Deluxe will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable local, state, and federal law.


Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the terms of the Americans with Disabilities Act and certain state or local laws. A reasonable accommodation is a change in the way things are normally done which will ensure an equal employment opportunity without imposing undue hardship on Deluxe. Please inform the company's HR representative if you need assistance completing any forms or to otherwise participate in the application process.


This role is based in Burbank, CA and the base pay range for this role is $50,000\.00 \- $56,000\.00 annually. Actual amounts will vary depending on education, skills, experience, and geographic location.

jobs.title: Marketing and Business Development Coordinator
jobs.description:
Marketing \& Business Development Coordinator

**Financial Services Agency**  
**Position:** Full\-Time  
**Reports To:** Agency Owner / Managing Director

About the Role

We are a growing financial services agency seeking a motivated, organized, and results\-oriented **Marketing \& Business Development Coordinator** to help expand our local presence, strengthen our digital marketing, and generate new client opportunities.

This is a hands\-on role combining **digital marketing, local business development, event marketing, referral development, and community outreach**.

The ideal candidate is not simply a social media content creator. We are looking for someone who understands that marketing should produce measurable business results: increased visibility, qualified leads, referral relationships, appointments, and ultimately new clients.

Key ResponsibilitiesDigital Marketing \& Lead Generation

Manage and continuously improve our digital presence and lead\-generation efforts, including:

* Coordinate website updates and improve local SEO and search visibility.
* Help optimize website pages, landing pages, calls\-to\-action, and lead\-capture forms.
* Manage or coordinate Google Ads campaigns, including keyword strategy, budgets, conversion tracking, and campaign optimization.
* Manage Yelp advertising and business profile presence where appropriate.
* Monitor Google Business Profile and other relevant local listings.
* Track website traffic, inquiries, conversions, cost per lead, and other key marketing metrics.
* Work with outside vendors, designers, web developers, or advertising partners when needed.

Social Media \& Content Marketing

Develop and execute a consistent social media and content strategy that strengthens our brand and creates opportunities for new business.

Responsibilities include:

* Plan and maintain a monthly social media/content calendar.
* Create and coordinate educational and promotional content.
* Develop posts, short\-form videos, graphics, client\-focused campaigns, and event promotions.
* Manage appropriate social platforms such as LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and others based on our target audience.
* Coordinate email campaigns and newsletters.
* Repurpose financial education and agency content across multiple channels.
* Track engagement and, more importantly, leads and appointments generated from campaigns.

All marketing materials must follow applicable company, regulatory, advertising, and compliance requirements for the financial services industry.

Referral \& Center\-of\-Influence Marketing

Help build a structured referral and relationship\-development program.

The coordinator will:

* Develop campaigns that encourage appropriate client introductions and referrals.
* Identify and cultivate relationships with potential **Centers of Influence (COIs)** such as CPAs, attorneys, real estate professionals, mortgage professionals, business owners, HR professionals, and other community partners.
* Coordinate outreach and follow\-up with referral partners.
* Help organize educational events, networking opportunities, workshops, and joint marketing activities.
* Maintain a database or CRM pipeline of referral partners, prospects, event attendees, and follow\-up opportunities.
* Track referral sources and measure which relationships and activities generate business.

Events \& Community Marketing

Plan and execute in\-person marketing activities designed to increase our visibility and create qualified business opportunities.

Activities may include:

* Client appreciation and referral events
* Educational seminars and workshops
* Community events
* Business networking events
* Chamber of Commerce and professional association events
* COI networking events
* Local sponsorships
* Employer and small\-business outreach
* Financial education presentations

Responsibilities include identifying opportunities, coordinating logistics, promoting events, managing registrations, attending events when appropriate, capturing prospect information, and ensuring timely follow\-up after each event.

Performance Expectations

Success in this position will be measured by business outcomes, not simply marketing activity.

Key performance indicators may include:

* Qualified leads generated
* New prospect appointments generated
* Cost per lead and cost per appointment
* Website organic traffic and local search visibility
* Google Ads conversion performance
* Event registrations and attendance
* Leads and appointments generated from events
* Client referrals generated
* Number of active COI/referral relationships
* Opportunities generated through COIs
* Social and email campaign conversions
* Marketing\-influenced new client acquisition

The coordinator will maintain a simple monthly marketing dashboard showing activities, spending, leads, appointments, referral sources, and results.

QualificationsRequired

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience managing multiple marketing projects and deadlines.
* Working knowledge of social media marketing and content creation.
* Understanding of basic SEO and local search marketing.
* Comfortable using CRM, email marketing, analytics, and digital marketing tools.
* Strong organizational and follow\-up skills.
* Comfortable attending networking events and interacting professionally with clients, prospects, and community partners.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects.

Preferred

* Experience with Google Business Profile and local SEO.

The Niles Foundation (TNF) is a community\-based nonprofit organization working to advance environmental justice, food security, clean mobility, climate resilience, economic opportunity, and community well\-being.

Through initiatives such as the Halo Food Project, EVCLEAN15, community engagement programs, leadership development efforts, and climate resilience initiatives, TNF works alongside residents, partners, and stakeholders to create meaningful opportunities and lasting community impact.***\*\*\*Only serious candidates apply.***

**Position Summary**

The Strategic Operations Coordinator supports the daily operations and organizational activities of The Niles Foundation.

This role helps maintain organizational continuity by supporting communications, community engagement activities, events, administrative functions, and operational coordination across TNF initiatives. The Strategic Operations Coordinator works closely with the Director and team members to help ensure that projects, partnerships, events, and organizational priorities continue moving forward efficiently.

This position is ideal for someone who is dependable, organized, eager to learn, able to work independently, and enjoys being part of a collaborative team environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Administrative \& Organizational Support*

* Coordinate meetings and scheduling.
* Maintain organized digital files and records.
* Track action items, deadlines, and follow\-up tasks.

* Assist with community events, workshops, meetings, and outreach activities.

* Assist with surveys, sign\-ins, and community data collection activities.

*Operations Support*

* Support organizational systems and processes.
* Assist with project tracking and coordination.
* Help maintain organizational continuity and follow\-through.

**Qualifications**

*Minimum Qualifications*

* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.

*Preferred Qualifications*

**Who We're Looking For**

We're less concerned about finding the "perfect" candidate and more interested in finding the right person.

The ideal candidate is:

* Reliable and dependable
* Honest and trustworthy
* Self\-motivated and proactive
* Organized and detail\-oriented
* Able to work efficiently and independently
* Comfortable taking initiative and solving problems
* Professional and respectful in communications
* Works well in collaborative team environments
* Willing to learn new skills and take on new responsibilities
* Able to adapt to changing priorities
* Passionate about community\-centered work

**We value integrity, accountability, communication, teamwork, and a willingness to learn just as much as prior experience.**

*If you don't meet every qualification listed but believe you would be a strong fit for this role, we encourage you to apply.*

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a dynamic and detail\-oriented Logistics Operations and Administrative Coordinator to join our team. In this role, you will be the backbone of our supply chain activities, ensuring seamless coordination across warehouse distribution, transportation management, procurement, and inventory control. Your expertise will drive process improvements, optimize freight and shipping logistics, and support cross\-functional communication to uphold efficiency and compliance. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to a fast\-paced environment where your analytical skills and supply chain knowledge will make a tangible impact.

**Responsibilities**

* **CUSTOMER SERVICE / OPERATIONS \& ADMINISTRATIVE COORDINATOR**

**Department:** Freight Forwarding / Logistics  
**Reports To:** Operations Manager  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Customer Service / Operations \& Administrative Coordinator is responsible for providing responsive customer service while supporting the day\-to\-day operational and administrative requirements of the company.

The position will primarily function within Customer Service but will be cross\-trained and expected to assist Operations and Administration as business needs require.

The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, detail\-oriented, and capable of managing multiple responsibilities in a fast\-paced freight forwarding and logistics environment. The employee must be able to communicate effectively with customers, vendors, carriers, warehouse personnel, and internal departments while maintaining accuracy and proper documentation.

* Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned customers regarding shipments, schedules, documentation, rates, and general inquiries.
* Respond to customer emails and inquiries promptly and professionally.
* Provide customers with accurate shipment status updates, including delays, schedule changes, documentation issues, and other exceptions.
* Proactively communicate potential problems rather than waiting for customers to follow up.
* Coordinate with Operations, Warehouse, Sales/Business Development, carriers, agents, and destination stations to ensure proper shipment handling.
* Obtain and verify shipping instructions and required documentation.
* Monitor shipments Inbound and Outbound from receipt or booking through departure and/or final coordination.
* Maintain accurate customer and shipment records in the company's operating system.

* Escalate service issues, customer complaints, shipment discrepancies, or potential financial exposure to management promptly.
* Develop a working knowledge of individual customer requirements and ensure those requirements are communicated internally.

**2\. Operations Support \- Inbound and Outbound**

* Assist with booking and shipment coordination for ocean, air, and inland transportation.
* Coordinate pickup, delivery, receiving, and warehouse activities as required.
* Communicate with carriers, truckers, warehouses, vendors, agents, and destination stations.
* Verify cargo information including piece count, dimensions, weight, commodity, routing, and special handling requirements.
* Assist with preparation and verification of shipping documents, including bills of lading, air waybills, manifests, delivery orders, and other operational documents.
* Monitor cutoff dates, sailing schedules, flight schedules, appointments, and shipment deadlines.
* Identify operational problems or discrepancies and immediately coordinate corrective action with the appropriate department.
* Assist Operations during high\-volume periods, employee absences, special projects, or other operational requirements.
* Follow established SOPs and internal controls when processing shipments.

**3\. Administrative Support**

* Assist with data entry, filing, scanning, document preparation, and record maintenance.
* Verify that required supporting documents are complete before files are closed or forwarded for billing.
* Assist with invoice verification and identification of discrepancies before submission to Accounting.
* Maintain customer, vendor, carrier, and operational records as assigned.
* Assist management with administrative activities and departmental coordination.

**CROSS\-FUNCTIONAL EXPECTATION**

Although Customer Service will be the employee's primary responsibility, this position is designed to be adaptable across Customer Service, Operations, and Administration.

The employee will be cross\-trained in relevant functions and may be assigned responsibilities in other areas depending on workload, staffing requirements, operational priorities, and business needs.

Cross\-training is intended to improve departmental coverage, operational continuity, and the employee's overall understanding of the freight forwarding process.

**PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS**

The employee is expected to:

* Take ownership of assigned tasks and follow them through to completion.
* Be proactive rather than waiting for customers or supervisors to identify problems.
* Communicate delays, discrepancies, and potential issues immediately.
* Maintain accuracy in shipment information and documentation.
* Prioritize customer requirements while protecting the company's operational and financial interests.
* Follow established procedures while demonstrating good judgment when unusual situations arise.
* Work independently after appropriate training and minimize unnecessary dependency on supervisors.
* Cooperate effectively with other departments and stations.
* Maintain professional communication with customers, vendors, carriers, and coworkers.
* Continuously develop knowledge of freight forwarding and logistics operations.

jobs.title: Community Outreach Worker
jobs.description:
**About AADAP, Inc.** The Asian American Drug Abuse Program (AADAP) is a 501(c)(3\) non\-profit organization dedicated to serving Asian Pacific Islanders and other underserved communities with substance abuse services throughout Los Angeles County. Programs and services are provided to all individuals regardless of race or ethnicity.

**Department Overview** The Community Integrated Prevention (CIP) unit within the Prevention Department drives health equity, environmental advocacy, and community education around alcohol, tobacco, and other drugs (ATOD) across the South Bay (SPA 8\) region. Through youth and adult coalition building, policy advocacy, and community outreach, CIP empowers residents to create safer, healthier environments.

**Position Summary** The CIP Outreach Worker supports alcohol and other drug (AOD) education and prevention outreach across the South Bay (SPA 8\) region. Reporting directly to the Prevention CIP Coordinator and guided by Community Organizers (CO I and CO II), this position assists with community presentations, trainings, digital content creation, event tabling, and volunteer engagement to drive social and policy change.

**Essential Job Functions \& Responsibilities**

**Target Area Organizing**

* Assist Community Organizers with preparing and delivering alcohol, tobacco, and other drug (AOD) education presentations, workshops, and trainings across SPA 8\.
* Assist in mobilizing community members for policy campaigns aimed at reducing youth access to alcohol, tobacco, and other drugs.
* Support the educational development of youth and adult coalition members in collaboration with local and regional prevention partners.
* Assist with conducting comprehensive community assessments across assigned target areas in the South Bay (SPA 8\) region.
* Develop creative educational outreach materials using media advocacy, including social media posts/reels, flyers, virtual training videos, and podcasts.
* Educate, inform, and cultivate awareness around ATOD issues with city, county, and state decision\-makers and city staff.
* Support the implementation of Strategic Prevention Framework (SPF) action plans by engaging local youth and adult volunteers.
* Transport supplies, media materials, and outreach equipment to field sites using a personal vehicle.
* Provide recommendations for contract plans based on emerging community needs, trends, and issues.

**County\-Wide Organizing**

* Participate in county\-based roundtables, regional task forces, and coalition\-based meetings.
* Assist with community advocacy surrounding local, state, and federal policy decisions impacting prevention.

**Administrative Support**

* Comply with city, county, state, and federal contractual agreements.
* Maintain accurate field documentation, outreach logs, and evaluation files.
* Prepare and submit billing reports and required administrative tracking documentation on time.

**Department \& Agency**

* Attend required department, unit, and agency\-sponsored meetings and events.
* Represent AADAP professionally at local, state, and federal forums, conferences, and community gatherings.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* **Education:** High School Diploma or equivalent (GED) required.
* **Transportation:** Valid California Driver’s License, active personal vehicle insurance, and reliable transportation.
* **Special Qualification:** Must have three (3\) years of continuous recovery or a drug\-free lifestyle as of the date of application.

**Nice to Have**

* Bilingual or bicultural capabilities in Los Angeles County threshold languages (e.g., Spanish, Tagalog, Korean, Samoan, Tongan, Hawaiian, or other AAPI languages); Spanish fluency strongly preferred.
* Knowledge of substance use disorders, AOD prevention, and community issues in the South Bay (SPA 8\) region.
* Experience creating digital media content (social media graphics, reels, flyers, or basic video editing).

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSAs)**

* Ability to get along well with others, be punctual, pleasant, and tactful with professional appearance and conduct.
* Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with supervisors, coworkers, clients and their families, community organizations, and the general public.
* Demonstrates cultural awareness and empathy across age groups, gender identity, sexual orientation, spiritual beliefs, socioeconomic status, and diverse cultures.
* Demonstrated knowledge and skill in computer operations and basic data entry for outreach tracking.
* Ability to understand community concerns deeply, listen actively, and build authentic rapport with diverse groups.
* Ability to pivot calmly in field environments, troubleshoot unexpected events, and work collaboratively with supervisors, peers, and external partners.
* Basic experience with media content creation, including social media graphics, reels, flyers, or video editing. (Preferred)
* Ability to comfortably present information, co\-facilitate workshops, and engage youth and adult community members during public events and tabling outreach. (Preferred)
* Ability to manage field logistics, transport and set up outreach supplies, and work independently with minimal direct supervision. (Preferred)

**Special Requirements**

* Employment contingent upon successful background check clearance.
* Permanent resident or U.S. Citizen; proof of work eligibility required upon hire.
* TB test within seven (7\) days of hiring.

**Work Schedule, Travel \& Physical Demands**

* **Schedule:** Part\-time, regular (20 hours per week); requires flexibility for occasional evening and weekend community events.
* **Travel:** Local field travel required throughout the South Bay (SPA 8\) region using a personal vehicle.
* **Physical Requirements:** Moderate Duty. Requires standing or walking most of the time, with frequent bending, stooping, squatting, twisting, reaching, and working on irregular surfaces.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Commercial Named
jobs.description:
At BuildOps, we're building a groundbreaking software solution, purpose\-built to support today's commercial contractors. From helping our customers to manage their service all the way to project management, we're breaking the mold and building a team that invests in our mission statement. We love driven, self\-motivated folks experienced in tech start\-ups and thrive in fast\-paced environments. Could you be our next hire?



As our Named Commercial Customer Success Manager, you will join a well\-funded, fast\-growing technology startup with the unique opportunity to help shape and scale a critical customer segment for the company.



The successful candidate will be responsible for managing a portfolio of commercial customers, driving adoption and utilization of the platform in your accounts, executing defined success playbooks, and proactively identifying and addressing portfolio risk. Our engagement model blends digital\-first and AI\-driven touchpoints with meaningful human intervention, ensuring customers receive the right level of support at the right time. The ideal candidate is someone who works hard, demonstrates strong analytical thinking, and is passionate about driving measurable value and outcomes for their customers.


### **What you'll do:**


* **Customer Engagement:** Build strong relationships with key customer stakeholders through digital first engagement and proactive touchpoints. Manage a healthy portfolio of Commercial accounts, ensuring customers receive maximum value from our platform at every stage of their journey.
* **Product Expert and Educator:** Become a BuildOps product expert and teach customers how to use the platform to its full potential. Learn the BuildOps platform in depth, understand how customers use it across their business workflows, and guide customers through configuration, feature adoption, and process improvements.
* **Workflow Discovery and Technical Enablement:** Translate customer workflows and pain points into clear recommendations. Escalate product gaps or technical issues to Product, Engineering, Support, or Professional Services when appropriate. Drive feature adoption and utilization across your portfolio and proactively share best practices around new feature releases to maximize customer outcomes.
* **Success Planning:** Craft and execute tailored Success Plans with a clear emphasis on value realization. Identify customer business workflows, pain points, and goals to develop solutions that deliver measurable outcomes, drive product adoption, and support long term retention and expansion.
* **Executive Business Reviews:** Build and present business reviews for rapidly growing customers, focused on driving value, adoption, and account expansion while building relationships with business owners.
* **Portfolio Health and Risk Management:** Monitor customer health and usage data across your portfolio to proactively identify risk signals and intervene before issues escalate. Build and execute playbooks to address at risk customers and manage portfolio risk with urgency and precision.
* **Customer Champion and Cross Functional Coordinator:** Serve as a proactive escalation point and tireless customer advocate. Coordinate seamless handoffs across the customer journey with Professional Services, Customer Support, and the Customer Experience team to ensure a consistent, high quality experience at every stage.
* **Advocacy and Account Growth:** Develop customer references and success stories while identifying referral and expansion opportunities.
* **Cross Functional Collaboration and Segment Development:** Work cross functionally with partners across Business Development, Product and Engineering, Sales, Professional Services, and Marketing to align on customer needs and drive company wide outcomes. Contribute new ideas to commercial playbooks and help drive segment level insights and best practice development to continuously elevate how we serve our commercial customers.

### **What we look for:**


* 1\-2 years of experience in customer success, client success, software implementation, or technical account management.
* B.A. or B.S. degree
* Experience learning and becoming an expert in an operating platform, ERP, or similar type of software platform.
* Demonstrated ability to learn complex software quickly and become a trusted product expert for customers.
* Ability to understand customer business processes, map workflows to software functionality, identify gaps, and explain practical solutions to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Experience training customers live on software, troubleshooting workflow or adoption issues, and using product usage data to idetnify opportunities or risks.
* Extraordinary people skills: must be empathetic, patient, confident, and able to interact well with a broad spectrum of personality types.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to explain complex concepts, software workflows, and answer questions in a clear and concise manner.
* Highly organized with the ability to manage a portfolio of accounts, prioritize across competing demands, and stay focused on customer and company goals.
* Comfortable operating within defined playbooks and structured processes, with the curiosity and initiative to contribute improvements and iterate on them over time.
* Self\-motivated, driven to succeed, fast learning and ability to thrive in a fast paced, dynamic startup environment
* Prior experience or ability to learn internal tools including Salesforce, Gainsight, Service Cloud, and Jira.

### **Bonus:**


* Familiarity with digital CS engagement models, tech\-touch strategies, or AI\-assisted customer success workflows.
* Experience in specialty contractor or construction industry.
* Experience with Accounting ERP systems like Netsuite, Quickbooks Online/Enterprise, Sage 300 CRE/Intacct, Viewpoint Vista/Spectrum

### **Compensation:**


* Los Angeles: $76,000 \- $95,000 base salary range

* Highly accurate, attentive, and detail\-oriented

EDUCATION\-CERTIFICATION

EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

WORK ENVIRONMENT

GumGum is The Mindset Company™ transforming advertising. We're an advertising technology company delivering results by matching brands with people in the right mindset in the moments that matter. Our platform is powered by the Mindset Graph™, our AI\-driven data engine that processes billions of real\-time contextual, creative, environmental, and historical signals to match every ad with the most receptive audience. The result is advertising that drives meaningful outcomes for advertisers and publishers, and is more relevant for consumers.



We were founded in 2008 and are headquartered in Santa Monica, California, operating in over 19 markets across North America, Europe, Japan, and Australia.



Our principles guide our work every day and are as follows:


* **Customer\-Obsessed:** We're focused on advertising solutions that solve needs and drive success for clients and partners.
* **Make it Happen:** We have a bias for action and take ownership to deliver results.
* **Always Innovate:** We push boundaries with creativity and technology.
* **Foster Belonging:** We ensure colleagues feel included, supported, and empowered to thrive.


To be a part of The Mindset Company™ transforming advertising, please visit www.gumgum.com/careers.


The HR Operations Specialist is a core member of GumGum's People Operations team, responsible for the day\-to\-day execution of benefits administration, immigration support, compensation operations, and recurring People programs.  

  

This role sits between our People Ops coordinators and the specialists who own strategy in each domain, providing the operational execution, data integrity, and process support that keeps the People function running smoothly across benefits, immigration, compensation, and program delivery.  

  

The ideal candidate is an organized, detail\-oriented generalist who is comfortable moving across HR domains rather than specializing in one, and who uses tools like ChatGPT or Claude to work efficiently and accurately.  

  

This role reports to the VP, People \& Culture.



Note: GumGum fosters a flexible work environment, offering GumGummers the ability to work either in\-office or remotely/from home. However, for occasional in\-person collaboration, we kindly ask that this position be located within a 'commutable' distance to our office.


**What You'll Achieve**


* Own day\-to\-day benefits administration and drive the annual open enrollment cycle end to end — enrollments, qualifying life events, invoice reconciliation, and COBRA coordination.
* Partner with the team's immigration point of contact to keep cases and filing deadlines on track, and own I\-9 and E\-Verify execution outright.
* Maintain the compensation data the whole People function runs on: the variable pay index, the job architecture and levelling library, and submissions to our benchmarking partners.
* Build the analysis behind real pay decisions — band placement, compa\-ratio, and offer analytics the team acts on.
* Keep recurring People programs moving on cadence, from the performance review cycle to the annual compensation review to engagement surveys.
* Curate the People programs calendar so cycles land cleanly and never collide.
* Work alongside our People systems owners on data integrity and audits across HR tools like ChartHop.
* Take on cross\-domain special projects as they surface — a generalist seat with genuine range.


**Skills You'll Bring**


* 3\+ years in HR or People Operations, comfortable moving across benefits, immigration, compensation, and program support rather than specializing in one.
* Proven ability to run a defined process independently once trained — processing enrollments, reconciling data, or preparing reports.
* Experience supporting a recurring People program such as open enrollment or a performance cycle as part of a team.
* Hands\-on fluency in an HRIS or payroll system such as ADP Workforce Now.
* A reconciliation instinct: you can put two data sets side by side, like invoices against enrollment records, and spot what doesn't line up.
* Strong organization and deadline awareness — you track multiple recurring processes at once, follow documented process closely, and escalate exceptions rather than improvise.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including fielding employee questions on benefits and process with confidence.
* AI literacy — you use tools like ChatGPT or Claude to draft communications, analyze data, and troubleshoot faster, with real examples to point to.


**What We Offer**



At GumGum, competitive base pay is a part of a total rewards package which also includes benefits, an emphasis on recognition, development, and wellness. The reasonable estimated base pay range for this role is from ***$86,000 \- $106,000*** ***annually.*** The actual amount may be higher or lower. jobs.description:
### **Position**

Loro Piana is an Italian luxury Maison founded in 1924, known for creating the finest quality textiles, ready\-to\-wear collections, accessories, and bespoke garments. Our dedication to exceptional craftsmanship and use of the world’s finest raw materials positions us a leader in the luxury industry. As an iconic Maison within the LVMH group, we uphold a strong commitment to unparalleled quality and excellence.  



General Purpose of the Position:


We are seeking a Seasonal Operations Specialist to join our team at Loro Piana. The Operations Specialist plays a pivotal role in the overall success of the business by supporting all operational and inventory\-related activities. You will be responsible for managing incoming and outgoing shipments, replenishing products on the sales floor, and organizing inventory to maximize efficiency. You will collaborate with all members of the team to ensure that stockroom conditions align with Loro Piana standards, contributing to seamless store operations.


### **Job responsibilities**

Key Responsibilities


* Optimize inventory flow and streamline operational processes while handling the accurate processing of shipments and transfers.
* Oversee the movement of merchandise from the stockroom to the sales floor and maintain appropriate inventory levels to align with sales potential.
* Conduct cycle counts as per corporate calendar to verify product quantities and report discrepancies in a timely manner. Perform regular audits to verify product conditions.
* Facilitate the implementation of security measures through inspections, audits, and preparing products for display.
* Ensure ongoing inventory organization according to company procedures and establish an optimized warehouse layout for improved accessibility by the sales team.
* Maintain clean, neat, and organized stock rooms with proper labeling to facilitate sales.
* Maintain effective communication with the operations team and external couriers to ensure accurate shipping procedures and timely delivery.
Provide the sales team with detailed updates regarding inventory availability to support the sales process and enhance sales performance.  
* 
### **Profile**

Skills and Abilities Required


* 3\+ years of operational and inventory experience, preferably in a luxury retail environment.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, SAP, and other digital tools.
* Excellent communication, teamwork, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong knowledge of operations and inventory control.
* Ability to lift and move objects up to 40 pounds.
### **Additional information**

What we offer


At Loro Piana, we believe in fostering a supportive and rewarding work environment that values our employees' well\-being and growth. We offer a comprehensive range of benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage, fertility support, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, tuition reimbursement, 401K match, and Headspace mental health support. Additionally, employees enjoy a generous product discount, exclusive LVMH discounts, and other tailored perks.


Compensation


Loro Piana uses the published salary range as a guideline to provide our employees with market\-competitive pay while allowing for flexibility to recognize and reward various levels of expertise, performance, and tenure.
  

  

While the published salary range is a good faith reflection of the targeted salary level for the position, Loro Piana reserves the right to pay outside of the published salary range of $24 to $26 USD per hour.
  

  

EEO Statement


We strive to create a culture of inclusion where everyone has a sense of belonging. Our goal is to ensure that our outreach and recruiting efforts generate diverse identities and perspectives that will be valued and can thrive. We are continuously assessing our employee and candidate populations to identify ways to ensure they are all\-encompassing and equitable.


***LORO PIANA***
**MAISON**
---------------------------

Originally from Trivero in northern Italy, the Loro Piana family began trading wool in the early 1800s. In 1924, Pietro Loro Piana founded Ing. Loro Piana \& C., the current company. Pietro’s nephew Franco took over in 1941, and after the war the firm began to establish its reputation as a supplier of premium wool and cashmere textiles for a growing haute couture industry, both home and abroad. In the 1970s, Sergio and Pier Luigi Loro Piana took up the reins, diversifying into luxury goods and developing an international retail arm. Now the world’s foremost cashmere processor, Loro Piana prides itself on sourcing the very finest, rarest raw materials the world has to offer, including unique cashmere from baby goats in northern China and Mongolia, vicuña from the Andes, extra\-fine Merino wool from Australia and New Zealand and lotus flower fiber from Myanmar. The company draws on both time\-honored traditions and state of the art technology to offer its discerning customers products that are renowned for their peerless quality. All of the company’s collections of ready\-to\-wear garments and accessories are made in Italy to the highest standards of craftsmanship and sartorial excellence.

jobs.description:
**Welcome to MFour**

  

At MFour, we’re transforming how businesses understand consumers in an increasingly complex, AI\-driven world. Founded in 2011, we are a leading consumer intelligence platform delivering validated, connected, and opt\-in data that powers smarter, faster decision\-making.

  

What sets us apart is our ability to connect what consumers say with what they actually do. Through our proprietary platform, MFour Studio™ and our flagship app Surveys On The Go®, we combine survey data with real\-world behaviors, creating a complete, accurate view of the consumer journey.

  

We’re also shaping the future of research through innovations like **DANI™**, our AI\-powered assistant that enables teams to quickly analyze data, uncover insights, and take action with confidence.  

  

Built on our Fair Trade Data® model, everything we do is grounded in transparency, privacy, and trust. Today, we partner with leading global brands like Google, Microsoft, and Disney to eliminate blind spots and drive better business decisions.

  

At our core, we believe better data leads to better outcomes!

 **Your Journey to Success:**


As our Senior Project Manager / Customer Success Manager, you'll own the end\-to\-end client experience for a portfolio of 20–30 MFour Data Research accounts — you're the person your clients count on from project kickoff through delivery and renewal. Three things define success here: keeping clients informed and confident through clear, proactive communication; making your client the hero of their own story by putting DANI™ in MFour Studio™ to work for them; and coordinating our internal teams — panel/sample, data science, and product — so every project lands on time, on budget, and on spec. This is a hybrid role based out of our Irvine, CA office, reporting to the VP and Manager of Customer Success.

 **Your Mission:**

* Own day\-to\-day client management at both the account and project level for a portfolio of 20–30 MFour Data Research accounts.
* Coordinate cross\-functionally with panel/sample operations, research, and product teams to keep every project on time, on budget, and on spec.
* Guide clients through the SaaS/DaaS customer journey, driving adoption and consumption of MFour Studio™ and DANI™.
* Identify and help close upsell and expansion opportunities inside existing accounts — additional data products, new SaaS/DaaS features and services.
* Build new client relationships and strengthen existing ones by presenting data\-driven insights that make your clients look good to their stakeholders.

 **What Sets You Apart**

* 3–5 years in quantitative research, preferably supplier\-side (research firm, panel company, or insights platform).
* 3–5 years working with large data sets, plus hands\-on experience designing questionnaires and analysis reports.
* Proven experience managing and communicating with multiple external clients at the same time.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, including presenting data\-driven insights directly to clients.
* Completed Bachelor's degree or higher, with strong MS Office proficiency.

 **Preferred Skills:**

* An AI\-first mentality — you're already using AI tools and LLMs to speed up analysis and client deliverables.
* Experience with SaaS/DaaS customer journey management and user consumption strategy.
* The intangibles: sharp attention to detail, comfort multitasking against deadlines, and the kind of follow\-through that keeps clients coming back.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing & Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
***About the Role***

If you live on TikTok, know why some Reels take off while others die quietly, have strong opinions about what makes content feel authentic, and love the idea of helping build consumer brands from the inside keep reading.

Erth Wellness is looking for a creative, highly motivated **Digital Marketing \& Social Media Manager** to own the strategy, growth, and day\-to\-day social presence of our portfolio of consumer brands, including DALY, Daily Pet Co., Erth Wellness, and other emerging brands.

This role will have significant ownership over how our brands show up across social and social commerce. You’ll be expected to evaluate opportunities, make recommendations, test new ideas, and use performance data to determine where we should focus next.

**This is not a role for someone who simply schedules posts.**

We want someone who can spot an opportunity, come up with the idea, grab a phone or camera, create the content, get it live, engage with the audience, look at the results, and figure out what we should do next.

You should be equally comfortable brainstorming a TikTok concept, filming and editing a Reel, setting up products on TikTok Shop, jumping on a trend before it’s over, responding to comments, working with creators, and finding the next opportunity to turn social engagement into actual sales.

You’ll have access to an in\-house photographer and creative resources, but we want someone who is comfortable **creating content themselves** and doesn’t need a full production setup to make something great.

If you’ve worked with **energy drinks, supplements, wellness, fitness, pet products, food \& beverage, or CPG brands**, even better.

***What You’ll Own***

Social Strategy \& Growth

You’ll own the day\-to\-day social presence of multiple Erth Wellness brands across:

* TikTok
* Instagram
* Facebook
* LinkedIn
* TikTok Shop
* Emerging social and social\-commerce platforms

Own the social media strategy, content direction, publishing cadence, and channel growth strategy across multiple Erth Wellness brands.

**You’ll have the autonomy to identify, evaluate, and act on relevant social trends, platform opportunities, creators, content formats, and social\-commerce opportunities without requiring day\-to\-day direction.**

You’ll post consistently, engage with our communities, respond to comments, monitor trends, and find ways for our brands to join relevant conversations without feeling like a brand trying too hard to join a conversation.

Most importantly, we want you paying attention to what’s next: new formats, algorithm changes, creators, trends, sounds, features, platforms, and selling opportunities, and making recommendations on where we should invest our time and resources.

***Create Content People Actually Want to Watch***

We don’t want to create content just to fill a calendar.

You’ll take ideas from concept to execution, including:

* Short\-form video for TikTok, Reels, and Stories
* Product and lifestyle content
* Trend\-driven and reactive content
* Educational and product\-benefit content
* Behind\-the\-scenes content
* Team and personality\-driven content
* Launch and promotional content
* Event and activation content
* Social\-first photography

Photography experience is a big plus. We have an in\-house photographer for larger shoots and polished brand assets, but we’d love someone who can independently capture great product, lifestyle, event, and social content when the moment calls for it.

You’ll also work closely with our photographer, designers, product team, sales team, and leadership on larger campaigns and creative ideas.

This is still a hands\-on role. Strategy and execution go together here. You should be equally comfortable developing the content direction for a brand and grabbing a phone to shoot, edit, and publish something when an opportunity arises.

***Turn Social Into Sales***

A major part of this position will be determining how we use social media and social commerce to drive measurable revenue across our brands.

You’ll own the strategy and ongoing optimization of TikTok Shop and other social\-commerce channels, including:

* Product listings
* Promotions
* Shoppable content
* Creator partnerships
* Affiliate opportunities
* Platform campaigns and initiatives
* Testing new ways to increase conversion

You’ll evaluate performance, identify opportunities, recommend and implement tests, and determine which strategies should be scaled, adjusted, or discontinued based on results.

We want someone who is constantly asking: **“How else can we sell this?”**

***Influencers, Creators \& UGC***

Help us find the right people to talk about our brands.

You'll own the identification and development of creator, influencer, athlete, affiliate, and UGC relationships that align with each brand's audience and business objectives.

You'll develop and manage:

* UGC
* Creator campaigns
* Social collaborations
* Ongoing creator partnerships

You'll evaluate potential partners, recommend where we should invest, monitor performance, and determine which relationships and programs should be expanded, optimized, or discontinued.

***Help Shape and Build Brands***

One of the best parts of this role is that you won’t be working on the same type of product every day.

For **DALY**, you may be creating content around energy, fitness, performance, lifestyle, events, sampling, or a new product launch.

For **Daily Pet Co.**, you could be developing pet wellness content, working with pet creators, supporting a retail launch, or figuring out how to make a gummy supplement for dogs go viral.

For our brands, you'll play a key role in determining how each one should look, sound, grow, engage, and sell through social, while adapting the strategy to the audience, category, stage of growth, and business objectives of each brand.

You’ll also have opportunities to create content around **product launches, retailer launches, trade shows, fitness events, sampling

jobs.title: HR Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Summary:**


Provides accurate, responsive, and compliance\-focused support across HR operations and the employee lifecycle. The HR Operations Coordinator processes workforce transactions, responds to employee and leader inquiries, maintains HR records, supports reporting and audits, and coordinates cross\-functional activities involving Human Resources, HR Technology, Payroll, Benefits, Information Technology, Information Security, Legal, and Records Management. The role also supports regulatory remediation activities, including Matters Requiring Attention (MRAs), by helping maintain data inventories, execute approved employee\-data retention and deletion procedures, validate results, and preserve audit evidence.

**Responsibilities:**

* Processes and monitors employee lifecycle transactions, job and organizational changes, contingent worker updates, leaves, terminations, rescissions, and related employee data corrections in Workday and connected service channels.
* Reviews requests for completeness, required approvals, effective dates, supporting documentation, and alignment with established policies, procedures, and service expectations before processing or escalation.
* Responds to routine employee and leader questions through HRConnect, shared inboxes, and other approved support channels; document activity, route complex matters to the appropriate HR partner and follow through to resolution.
* Maintains accurate and confidential personnel records, transaction documentation, acknowledgments, and operational evidence in accordance with company retention, privacy, legal\-hold, and records\-management requirements.
* Supports standard and ad hoc HR reporting, transaction audits, data\-quality reviews, exception tracking, and reconciliations; identify discrepancies and coordinate timely corrections with HR Technology or the responsible business owner.
* Assists with recurring HR programs and operational activities, including performance and compensation cycles, workforce changes, policy acknowledgments, labor\-law posting administration, work authorization tracking, and special projects.
* Partners with HR Technology and IT to troubleshoot system or workflow issues, document defects, test approved changes, and confirm that employee lifecycle processes operate as intended across Workday and downstream systems.
* Prepares process documentation, job aids, control evidence, status updates, and supporting materials for internal audits, external audits, compliance reviews, and management reporting.
* Recommends practical improvements that strengthen accuracy, timeliness, controls, employee experience, and scalability across HR operational processes.
* Supports MRA\-related workstreams involving employee data classification, retention, disposition, deletion, de\-identification, and access controls under the direction of the designated business, application, data, or risk owner.
* Maintains current inventories of HR applications, employee\-data locations, system owners, downstream interfaces, retention requirements, legal hold exceptions, and approved deletion or de\-identification rules.
* Coordinates approved deletion exercises by compiling employee populations, validating exclusions, distributing identifiers only through approved secure methods, tracking completion by system owners, and escalating delays or exceptions.
* Validates that approved HR system purge activities complete successfully and coordinate downstream confirmation, reconciliation, and issue resolution without independently changing legal, retention, security, or data\-classification requirements.
* Collects and organizes evidence of execution, including approvals, population files, validation results, exception logs, system\-owner confirmations, and remediation artifacts, in the designated controlled repository.

  



**Requirements**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* One (1\) \+ years of HR operations, HR coordination, HRIS support, records administration, compliance support, or related experience preferred.
* Experience supporting audits, data\-governance activities, regulatory remediation, or controlled operational processes is preferred.
* Working knowledge of HR operations and employee lifecycle processes; familiarity with Workday or a comparable enterprise HRIS is preferred.
* This is a hybrid position based in Irvine, CA or Chandler, AZ \- requiring two days per week.

The individual in this role will provide support for and play a coordinating role for the ALC's Election Protection and other voting rights advocacy this fall. The Temporary Project Coordinator will handle administration and logistics for poll monitoring, including correspondence and management of volunteers, polling place assignments, and related components; track and provide support for partner organizations, complete data analysis and research assignments in support of DNI projects, and other admin and support roles related to ALC's democracy defense work. * Correspondence and relationship management with volunteers

jobs.title: Client Experience & Office Coordinator
jobs.description:
Bay Area therapy practice seeking a part\-time coordinator to manage client intake and provide light support for our office and occasional events.

This role is ideal for someone warm, organized, and detail\-oriented who enjoys being the first point of contact for people seeking care. You'll manage prospective clients from first inquiry through matching them with a therapist and scheduling their first consult call. You'll also help keep our Piedmont office running smoothly with a weekly visit, and lend a hand at a handful of weekend workshops throughout the year.

About the Practice

* 4 therapy offices across 2 locations (plus subleases)
* \~20 clinicians
* 5 supervisors, including the practice founder, who leads workshops
* One virtual office manager (handles payroll and clinician onboarding part time)

Responsibilities

Client Intake

* Serve as the first point of contact for prospective clients (mainly via email)
* Track and follow up with prospective clients through the intake pipeline, with a focus on fast response times — we know prospective clients lose interest quickly if they don't hear back promptly
* Match clients to clinicians based on fit, specialty, and availability
* Schedule first consult calls
* Maintain accurate, up\-to\-date records in our practice management system (e.g., Simple Practice)
* \[nice to have] Identify where prospects drop off and help tighten the process — including using AI tools to speed up response times, draft communications, and improve the workflow

Office Support (weekly, in\-person)

* Visit the Piedmont office once a week to ensure it's organized, stocked, and well cared for (including the plants)
* Flag maintenance or cleaning issues to the appropriate contact and coordinate with our cleaner as needed
* Orient new clinicians to the office space and handle key transfer

Workshop Support (6–8x/year, weekends)

* Support weekend workshops led by the practice founder with setup, breakdown, and food logistics
* Weekend dates provided months in advance

Ideal Candidate

* Warm, professional phone/email presence — comfortable being someone's first contact with therapy
* Organized and reliable; responsive within a consistent window, with urgency around new inquiries
* Proficient with technology\- especially tools like Google Workspace (Docs, Calendar, Sheets)
* \[nice to have] experience using Simple Practice \[this is an intuitive platform \& easy to learn]
* Curious about and comfortable using AI tools to work smarter and faster — interested in building small processes and automations, not just following instructions
* Detail\-oriented and process\-minded
* Comfortable working independently with minimal oversight
* \[Nice to have]: open to light client correspondence on weekends (under 1 hour) — a plus given how much response speed matters to conversion
* Experience working as an intake coordinator or with therapy practices a plus

Logistics

* \~10 hours/week, mostly remote. Ability to correspond with clients within 12\-24 hours key given how much response speed matters to conversion
* One in\-person office visit required weekly
* Workshop support 6–8x/year (weekend dates provided months in advance)
* Weekend responsiveness a plus, not required
* Reports to the Practice Director

Pay: $25\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 10\.0 – 15\.0 per week

Application Question(s):

* Are you able to come in person once a week to our office in Oakland?
* Do you have any experience with process improvement or using AI to increase efficiency? Please share.
* Do you have experience as an intake coordinator or working in a therapy practice?

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Oakland, CA 94605

We represent people who've been seriously injured or lost a loved one, giving each client the attention, care, and representation they deserve. Bicycle Law is our brand dedicated to the cycling community. It's built to help riders who've been in an accident, and to stay connected with cyclists long before that ever happens. It's the identity most cyclists know us by, from sponsoring races and local group rides, to connecting with bike shops and building relationships with riders around the Bay Area.

Founded on the principle that achieving success for our clients comes only from fulfilled people who remain civil in the legal system’s adversarial process, Coopers LLP is constantly working to create the best culture of any law firm. Fostering a collaborative team culture and open\-door environment that supports each employee’s personal and professional growth and ensures the firm is a pleasant and fun environment is of utmost importance to our firm. We love what we do, and it shows.

jobs.title: Brand & Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**BRAND \& MARKETING COORDINATOR (Part\-Time to Full\-Time)**

Brucato Spirits · San Francisco, Mission District

20 hours/week minimum, full\-time preferred

We make amaro, gin, and liqueurs in a small distillery on South Van Ness, using California ingredients: heirloom apricots, house\-dried kumquats, botanicals from the state's fields and landscapes. We're a founder\-run company refocusing on the distillery itself — tours, events, new releases — and expanding distribution within California and . We're hiring one person to work directly with co\-founder Sierra Clark on all of our marketing and public\-facing work.

**ABOUT BRUCATO SPIRITS**

Brucato Spirits is a San Francisco craft distillery founded by Sierra and James Clark, who have formulated every recipe we've released. We're named for John Brucato, founder of San Francisco's first farmers market. Everything is distilled here, and most of our ingredients come from California farms and orchards. Our lineup includes four California amaros, Mission Gin, the Oro y Fierro kumquat liqueurs, and a series of small\-batch releases.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

This is a hands\-on, part\-time role supporting Sierra across brand, marketing, events, and sales. You'll be the person who keeps projects on schedule, turns ideas into finished work, and makes sure nothing gets dropped between a product launch, a photoshoot, a weekend tour, and next week's social media plan.

In your first year, you'll help launch new spirits, run a season of distillery events, contribute to how the brand looks and sounds, and build the systems that keep all of that organized. The role will grow with the company, and how it grows will depend partly on what you bring to it.

No two days will be the same.

**WHAT THE WORK IS ACTUALLY LIKE**

Much of this job is not glamorous. It's proofreading a label for the fourth time, tracking down a vendor who hasn't replied, moving boxes before a photoshoot, updating a spreadsheet, and rewriting a run\-of\-show the night before an event. The interesting parts — launches, shoots, events, learning production — only happen if the detailed work gets done first. We are looking for someone who takes that part seriously.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

● Support new spirits from concept to launch: packaging and label details, timelines, copy, launch materials, and the many small tasks involved in getting a release out.

● Manage social media and the website day to day with Sierra and our partners: content calendars, posting plans, scheduling, and website updates.

● Coordinate distillery events, from tours and tastings to launches and partner nights: planning, logistics, vendors, run\-of\-show, and working the event itself.

● Plan and oversee photoshoots: concept, shot lists, props, scheduling, and directing on set. This may include booking or hiring photographers, stylists, or assistants.

● Create sales and marketing materials (sell sheets, menus, signage, printed pieces, presentations) and manage outside designers or printers when needed.

● Industry and sales support: design and support partnerships, events, and creative activations.

● Contribute creative strategy: bring ideas and help develop campaigns and brand initiatives.

● Represent the brand at tastings, industry events, and with accounts as needed.

**INSIDE THE DISTILLERY**

This role is based at the distillery, alongside the people who make the spirits. You'll learn how production works, and if you're interested in bottling, blending, or distilling, there will be opportunities to participate.

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

**Required**

● At least two years in a role where you were responsible for keeping projects, events, or content on schedule for someone else.

● Extremely organized and detail\-oriented. You keep lists, follow through, and catch mistakes before they go out.

● Creative, with a good eye and the ability to take a rough idea and produce something finished.

● Comfortable talking with the public on a tour, at an event, or behind a table.

● Self\-directed. You identify what needs doing and do it without waiting for instructions.

● Work well in a small team where priorities change and everyone covers more than one job.

● Able to work on\-site in San Francisco most weeks. Set on\-site hours will be decided together with the person we hire.

● 21 or older.

**Nice to have**

● Experience in spirits, wine, beer, hospitality, or food.

● Experience with social media management, photography or art direction, event production, and graphic design (Canva, Adobe Suite, or similar).

**DETAILS**

● Part\-time requires 20 hours per week, minimum. Full\-time option, with additional scope.

● Mostly on\-site at the distillery at set times, with some work from home.

● Occasional evenings or weekends for events.

● Compensation: Part\-time $30\-40/hr, or Full\-time salary of $60\-90K, plus benefits, depending on experience and scope of work.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Email sierra.clark@brucatospirits.com with "Brand \& Marketing Coordinator" in the subject line. Include:

1\. A short note about why you're interested in this role.

2\. A résumé.

3\. One example of something you organized or produced from start to finish — an event, a campaign, a shoot, a launch, a project. In a few sentences, tell us what went wrong along the way and how you handled it.

A portfolio, a social media account you've managed, or other examples of your work are welcome but not required.

Pay: $30\.00 \- $40\.00 per hour

Expected hours: No less than 20\.0 per week

Work Location: Hybrid remote in San Francisco, CA 94103

jobs.title: Operations Associate
jobs.description:

As a company, we promote a culture of honesty and integrity, and value the trust it allows us to build with customers and employees alike. Our focus on our people is what sets us apart and keeps our customers coming back to work with us!
  

If you are seeking to be a part of a family, this is the place for you!
  

  

We are an integrated logistics company responsible for moving 20% of global trade annually. With a dedicated team of over 110,000 employees across 130 countries, we go all the way to connect and simplify global trade and help our customers grow and thrive.
  

  

Maersk Ground Freight (MGF) offers transportation services like FTL (Full Truckload), LTL (Less Than Truckload), brokerage, cross\-border trucking, groupage, and sortation hubs, connecting Maersk or Customer warehouses or depots or cross\-dock/consolidation/deconsolidation facilities through a robust network led by best\-in\-class operations and technology. This integrated network will service multi\-channels like B2B, B2C, B2B2C, e\-commerce, direct to store, dropship, returns, and more, leveraging asset\-based, asset\-light, and non\-asset models.

This role works closely with delivery teams, Macy's customers, transportation providers, and internal stakeholders to ensure timely communication, operational compliance, and successful delivery execution.


Key responsibilities include monitoring delivery routes and service performance, managing customer and driver escalations, maintaining accurate records and documentation, facilitating communication across the delivery network, and providing real\-time solutions to operational challenges.


The Operations Support Associate plays a critical role in ensuring service expectations are met while supporting a positive customer experience and operational efficiency.


Success in this role requires strong communication skills, attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to multitask in a fast\-paced environment. The ideal candidate is dependable, trustworthy, highly organized, and proficient with computer systems and technology. They must be able to adapt quickly to changing priorities while maintaining a high level of professionalism and customer focus.

* Answer inbound phone calls, emails, and messages while providing a high level of customer service.
* Monitor daily delivery operations and track the progress of delivery teams to ensure on\-time service execution.
* Manage customer, driver, and partner escalations with professionalism and a sense of urgency.

* Maintain professionalism and composure while responding to time\-sensitive situations and operational challenges.

Qualifications


* High School Diploma or GED required.
* Minimum 1\-2 years of experience in customer service, operations support, administrative support, logistics, transportation, or a related field.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate professionally with customers, delivery teams, transportation partners, and internal stakeholders.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Excel, Word, and Teams.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
* Experience performing data entry, maintaining records, and compiling operational information.
* Ability to solve problems, exercise sound judgment, and make informed decisions with minimal supervision.
* Ability to remain calm, professional, and solution\-oriented when managing customer concerns, operational challenges, and time\-sensitive situations.
* Dependable, trustworthy, and capable of handling confidential and sensitive business information with discretion.
* Ability to adapt to changing priorities and business needs while maintaining a high level of service and professionalism.

Preferred Qualifications


* Experience in transportation, logistics, dispatch, supply chain, or last\-mile delivery operations.

**A Better Built World**
------------------------


At Miter, we’re on a mission to help construction contractors build with confidence. If we’re successful, we’ll make it easier and faster to build critical physical infrastructure \- roads, bridges, utilities, data centers, housing, etc.


For decades, construction and field services contractors have had to run their businesses on outdated software: clunky, on\-premise systems created in the 1980s and 1990s.


That’s where Miter comes in. We’re using AI and embedded payments to rebuild the core HR, finance, and operations systems that underpin our physical economy. Using Miter, contractors like Marathon Electrical, W.J. O’Neil, and Truebeck Construction are building stronger teams, controlling job costs, and accelerating jobsite execution.


This idea is resonating. Since we launched in 2021, we’ve grown to thousands of customers and tens of millions in ARR, making us one of the fastest growing vertical software companies ever. To double\-down on our momentum, we’ve raised $50M\+ from top investors (Bessemer, Coatue, and Battery) who share our belief that we’re just getting started.

**About the Team \& How We Work:**
----------------------------------


Our SDR team is the engine behind Miter’s pipeline growth — and we’re scaling it fast. As an Inbound SDR, you’ll be the first to connect with contractors who raise their hand to learn more about Miter, responding fast and turning that interest into qualified pipeline. You’ll work hand in hand with Marketing and Account Executives to make sure no opportunity slips through the cracks.


This is a high\-impact seat with plenty of room to get creative. You’ll help sharpen our qualifying and follow\-up motions, tie prospect pain to the right Miter modules, and shape a repeatable inbound playbook as the product evolves — working alongside sales, marketing, and leadership to test new ideas and accelerate revenue growth.


As the first point of contact for many of our future customers, you’ll set the tone for strong, lasting relationships and help contractors see the value of modern, industry\-leading tools. We’re committed to your growth: SDRs at Miter have a clear path into senior SDR roles, Account Executive positions, and beyond.

 **What You’ll Do:**

* Be the first point of contact for inbound leads — demo requests, content downloads, and marketing\-sourced leads — responding with a time\-to\-touch under 15 minutes
* Run qualifying and discovery conversations to surface prospect pain and tie it back to the relevant Miter modules
* Communicate Miter’s value proposition and business impact, booking qualified meetings (SALs) for Account Executives and managing clean handoffs
* Follow up persistently with every lead that no\-shows or doesn’t self\-book, re\-engaging across phone, email, and other channels
* Partner closely with Marketing on campaigns and lead quality, and own your activity and pipeline metrics in Salesforce

**What You’ll Need:**

* No prior experience required — prior SDR work, cold calling, or transferable experience from college (athletics, leadership, part\-time sales) is a plus

* Strong written and verbal communication — as the first point of contact at Miter, you’re energetic, personable, and make a great first impression
* A natural relationship builder who partners closely with AEs, asks sharp questions, and stays genuinely curious about every prospect
* Self\-motivated and coachable, with a strong desire to build a long\-term career in Sales
* Grit, resilience, and a strong work ethic — you bring consistent energy and bounce back quickly from a “no”
* A true team player above all — you win as a team and lift up the people around you

**Our Interview Process:**

* Recruiter Screen
* Hiring Manager Interview
* Take Home Assignment
* Final Executive Interview

**Our Benefits:**
-----------------

* **Competitive Compensation:** We offer competitive (well above “market”) salary, commission, and equity packages.
* **Medical Insurance:** Comprehensive medical, dental, FSA, vision plans to suit you and your family’s needs.
* **401(k) Retirement Plan:** Company\-matched contributions to help you plan for your future.
* **Flexible PTO:** Take the time you need to recharge and be your best self.
* **Parental Leave:** Generous 16\-week paid leave for all parents, including adoptive and foster parents.
* **Learning \& Development:** We offer every employee an annual educational allowance to explore external professional development.
* **Office Extras:** Snacks, coffee, lunch, and commuter benefits for in\-office Mitosaurs.
* **Community**: Company\-wide and team\-specific off\-sites per year.

**Hybrid vs. Remote Approach:**
-------------------------------


We believe the magic of Miter comes from working side by side. We also believe in work flexibility. For roles that are listed as **hybrid,** our approach is 3 days a week in the office giving us the chance to connect, brainstorm, and build stronger relationships. If you live within a reasonable commute to either our New York City or San Francisco offices, we ask that you work in our hybrid approach.


Otherwise, for roles listed as **remote** or in other cities where we don't have an office location, there is no requirement to work in our hybrid approach. We do travel a few times a year for onboarding, company\-wide and team specific off\-sites!

----------------------
