Job Description:
**Executive Assistant**  

  

**Join SE Ventures and power your career!**  

  

Discover the opportunity to join an international, dynamic, and fast\-growing venture capital fund investing in early\-stage companies focused on climate change, sustainability, and industrial technology. Every day, we empower employees to achieve more and experience exciting careers.  

  

Backed by Schneider Electric and located on Sand Hill Road in Menlo Park, SE Ventures offers a collaborative, fast\-paced environment where employees are encouraged to take initiative, contribute broadly, and grow their careers.  

  

Learn more about SE Ventures:  

https://www.seventures.com/home.jsp  

  

**About the Role**  

  

The Executive Assistant will provide high\-quality administrative support to designated members of the SE Ventures leadership team while contributing to the smooth day\-to\-day operation of the Menlo Park office.  

  

This is a collaborative, hands\-on role requiring discretion, sound judgment, flexibility, and a positive, team\-first mindset. In addition to supporting designated executives, this position will partner closely with the Head of Office Operations on routine office and team needs.  

  

Responsibilities may evolve based on executive, team, event, and office needs. The successful candidate will be comfortable stepping in where reasonably needed to help maintain a professional, organized, welcoming, and well\-functioning workplace. **Key Responsibilities** **Executive Support (approximately 80% of the role)*** Manage calendars, travel arrangements, itineraries, and expense reports for designated executives.
* Coordinate meetings and appointments across multiple time zones with internal and external stakeholders.
* Facilitate effective communication between supported executives, SE Ventures team members, Schneider Electric colleagues, startup founders, investors, other venture capital firms, and external parties.
* Prepare meeting materials, organize correspondence, take notes when requested, and track follow\-up items.
* Anticipate needs, identify scheduling or logistical conflicts, and proactively recommend solutions.
* Troubleshoot urgent travel, scheduling, and technology\-related issues, particularly while senior leaders are traveling.
* Provide administrative and project\-based support as business needs arise.
* Provide essential backup administrative coverage during planned PTO, sick leave, or other absences. Coverage will focus on urgent or time\-sensitive needs, including calendar management, travel assistance, meeting coordination, and other critical support necessary to maintain business continuity.
* Coordinate appropriate handoffs before planned absences and prioritize or escalate urgent requests that arise during unplanned absences.

**Office and Team Support (approximately 20% of the role)**  

  

In partnership with the Head of Office Operations:* Monitor inventory and assist with ordering, receiving, organizing, and replenishing office, kitchen, and meeting supplies.
* Regularly stock and organize snacks, beverages, coffee, refrigerators, and pantry areas.
* Prepare and reset conference rooms and shared spaces for meetings, visitors, catering, and office events.
* Greet visitors and help provide a professional and welcoming experience for external guests, visiting executives, and team members.
* Assist with catering orders, deliveries, setup, cleanup coordination, and other meeting or event logistics.
* Help receive office deliveries and coordinate routine vendor visits.
* Communicate facilities, equipment, supply, or workplace issues to the Head of Office Operations and assist with follow\-through as needed.
* Provide coverage for essential day\-to\-day office responsibilities during the Head of Office Operations’ planned or unplanned absence.
* Support local events, offsites, internal team activities, and visits from Schneider Electric executives or other external parties.
* Take on additional reasonable administrative or office\-support responsibilities as team and business needs evolve.

* Demonstrated experience managing executive calendars, travel, meetings, and expenses.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong proficiency with Outlook and experience managing calendars and correspondence on behalf of senior executives.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and other Microsoft Office applications.
* Experience with Coupa for procurement and Concur for travel and expenses is preferred.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to exercise independent judgment, maintain confidentiality, and handle sensitive or critical matters appropriately.
* Proactive and resourceful, with a high degree of initiative, ownership, attention to detail, and follow\-through.

**About the Company**


Marcus \& Millichap Company (MMC) is a real estate leader and pioneer with a diverse family of companies offering Real Estate Services, Real Estate Investments, and Real Estate Development. Each MMC company is a distinct fusion of real estate specialization and innovation, powered by a culture of loyalty that permeates throughout the Marcus \& Millichap organization. To find out more about the Company, visit www.mmcrealestate.com.


Please note that we are in a great location, near Caltrain, with excellent restaurants and shops within walking distance.

**Position Overview**


The Executive Assistant is a strategic partner to senior leadership, responsible for optimizing executive effectiveness, managing high\-priority workflows, and driving coordination across stakeholders. This role operates with a high degree of autonomy, judgment, and anticipation in a fast\-paced, high\-demand environment.


The position requires a proactive, highly polished professional who can manage complexity, influence outcomes, and serve as a trusted extension of the executive, while exercising exceptional discretion in handling highly sensitive and confidential information.


The position reports to the Chief of Staff and is based at the Company’s headquarters in Palo Alto, CA.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Executive Operations \& Strategic Calendar Management**
	+ Own and optimize executive calendars to align with strategic priorities
	+ Proactively identify scheduling conflicts, competing priorities, and opportunities for efficiency
	+ Ensure executives are fully prepared with context, materials, and clear objectives
	+ Maintain organized records, files, and documentation systems
* **Executive Meeting, Board \& Event Leadership**
	+ Lead planning and execution of executive, board, and other key leadership meetings, including board and investor interactions
	+ Develop agendas, coordinate stakeholders, and ensure alignment on desired outcomes
	+ Drive follow\-through and accountability on key action items
* **Strategic Communication \& Stakeholder Interface**
	+ Draft and manage executive communications with a high degree of discretion and judgment
	+ Serve as a trusted liaison for sensitive and confidential matters involving senior stakeholders
* **Travel, Expense \& Executive Logistics Optimization**
	+ Oversee complex travel planning with contingency planning and efficiency in mind
	+ Ensure logistics maximize executive productivity and minimize friction
	+ Monitor and improve administrative processes related to expenses and logistics
* **Executive Information \& Relationship Management**
	+ Maintain and synthesize key executive information, stakeholder insights, and priorities
	+ Manage relationships and ensure continuity across executive interactions
	+ Anticipate next steps and ensure continuity in stakeholder engagement
* **Strategic Projects \& Executive Enablement**
	+ Lead special projects and cross\-functional initiatives
	+ Conduct research, build executive\-ready presentations, and drive deliverables
	+ Identify opportunities to improve executive workflows and operating cadence

**Core Competencies**

* **Judgment \& Executive\-Level Decision Making** – Makes high\-quality decisions in complex situations
* **Ownership, Accountability \& Reliability** – Takes full ownership of outcomes and execution
* **Executive Communication \& Influence** – Builds trust and influences across stakeholders
* **Proactivity, Anticipation \& Adaptability** – Anticipates needs and resolves issues proactively

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree required
* 5 to 8\+ years of executive support experience, including senior leadership exposure
* Proven experience supporting complex, high\-demand executives
* Exceptional communication, organizational, and problem\-solving skills
* Proven ability to manage highly sensitive information with discretion, judgment, and professionalism

**Benefits Overview**


The compensation plan for this role is commensurate with the skills required for the position. As such, it is comprised of a base salary and an annual performance\-based incentive, which is determined upon individual and portfolio performance.


The Company offers a comprehensive benefits package including:

* Paid Time Off, Paid Holidays, and Paid Sick Time
* 401k \+ Employer Contribution
* Medical (H.S.A./HDHP option \+ Employer Contribution), Dental, and Vision Plan(s)
* Flexible Spending Accounts
* Group Term Life/AD\&D and Voluntary Life/AD\&D Plans
* Long\-Term Disability and Long\-Term Disability Buy\-Up Plans
* Employee Assistance Program
* Fitness \& Wellness Program
* Other Voluntary Plans


Depending on the role, other benefits such as commissions, an educational assistance program (tuition reimbursement), a referral program, and/or a car allowance may be applicable.

The Division of Environment and Planning aims to protect, restore, and expand New York City's green spaces and natural areas to maximize their benefits for environmental and community health and resilience. The Planning unit is at the forefront of Parks’ open space agenda: communicating agency goals, policies and advancing plans for a vibrant and sustainable park system that meets the recreational, social, and environmental needs of our city. The Administrative Coordinator will report to the chair of the Department of Architecture in the Spitzer School of Architecture at the City College of New York. jobs.title: Program Coordinator – Recess Coach (Harlem)
jobs.description:
**Turn Recess Into Something Kids Look Forward To!** ⚽

Program Coordinator – Recess Coach

**Love working with kids? Enjoy sports, games, movement, and bringing positive energy wherever you go?**

ITAV is looking for energetic, dependable, and enthusiastic **Program Coordinators – Recess Coaches** to help us transform recess into a fun, safe, inclusive, and meaningful part of the school day.

This isn't a job where you simply stand on the sidelines and watch.

You'll be **leading games, getting kids moving, encouraging teamwork, helping students work through conflicts, building confidence, and creating the kind of recess experience students can't wait to be part of.**

If you love working with young people and believe play can be a powerful way to teach leadership, communication, teamwork, and confidence — **we want to meet you!**

Who We Are

**ITAV** is a sports\-based youth development organization that uses sports, fitness, structured play, and engaging activities to help young people build confidence, communication skills, leadership, accountability, and positive relationships.

We believe kids learn some of life's most important lessons while they're moving, playing, competing, communicating, and having fun.

What You'll Be Doing

As a **Program Coordinator – Recess Coach**, you'll help bring energy, structure, and FUN to the school day.

You'll:

* Lead fun, age\-appropriate sports, games, and movement activities.
* Get students excited about participating — including kids who may not usually join in.
* Encourage teamwork, communication, sportsmanship, and fair play.
* Help students build confidence and leadership skills through play.
* Help students work through disagreements and practice healthy conflict resolution.
* Create an environment where every child feels welcomed and included.
* Actively supervise students and keep activities safe, organized, and engaging.
* Adapt games and activities to support students with different abilities and needs.
* Build positive relationships with teachers, school staff, students, and the ITAV team.
* Respond appropriately to student concerns, injuries, incidents, or unexpected situations.
* Support field days, special events, after\-school activities, and other ITAV programs when needed.

You'll Be Great at This If You...

* Genuinely enjoy working with children and young people.
* Bring positive energy into a room — or onto a playground!
* Aren't afraid to jump into a game and participate.
* Can confidently lead and engage groups of children.
* Know how to be fun **and** maintain appropriate boundaries.
* Are patient, dependable, responsible, and professional.
* Communicate well with children and adults.
* Can stay calm when things don't go exactly as planned.
* Believe every child should have an opportunity to participate and feel successful.
* Enjoy being part of a team.

What We're Looking For

**Required:**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Experience working with children or youth.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to lead games, activities, and groups of students.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
* Dependability and punctuality.
* Ability to work in active indoor and outdoor environments.

**Even Better If You Have:**

* Experience as a coach, camp counselor, recreation specialist, group leader, school aide, paraprofessional, or after\-school instructor.
* Experience working with students with disabilities or behavioral support needs.
* Sports, fitness, recreation, or youth development experience.
* Knowledge of positive behavior management or conflict\-resolution strategies.
* CPR or First Aid certification.

This Role Is Active!

You won't spend your day sitting behind a desk.

You'll be walking, moving, demonstrating games, setting up activities, interacting with students, and spending time indoors and outdoors.

If you enjoy an active workday, this may be a great fit.

Why Join ITAV?

Because **recess is more than free time.**

It's where kids can learn to communicate.

It's where they practice teamwork.

It's where confidence grows.

It's where new friendships happen.

And sometimes, it's where a young person discovers that they're a leader.

At ITAV, you'll have an opportunity to make those moments happen every day.

Ready to Bring the Energy?

If you're ready to **move, motivate, mentor, and make an impact**, we'd love to hear from you.

**Apply today and help ITAV create playgrounds and programs where every child has an opportunity to play, connect, grow, and thrive!**

Pay: $18\.00 \- $20\.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
Make a difference in the lives of New York City's residents and communities. For over 60 years PSS has performed vital and important work \- through its ten centers and affiliated programs. The agency touches the lives of over 2,000 people each day.

 **PROGRAM SUMMARY:**

  

**New York Connects:** NY Connects Brooklyn is a borough\-wide program funded by NYC Aging and administered in partnership with the New York State Office for the Aging (NYSOFA). The program provides free, unbiased, and comprehensive Information and Assistance (IA) on long\-term services and support (LTSS) for older adults, people with disabilities, caregivers, and professionals.

  

The Program Coordinator supports the Program Director in the effective day\-to\-day administration and operation of the NY Connects Brooklyn program, with primary responsibility for quality assurance, documentation compliance, data integrity, performance monitoring, and operational coordination.

  

The Program Coordinator conducts routine reviews of program documentation and service records, monitors contractual deliverables and performance metrics, identifies quality and compliance deficiencies, supports corrective action, and maintains systems that promote accurate reporting and high\-quality, person\-centered service delivery.

  

The position serves as an operational resource to program staff and supports the Program Director in maintaining compliance with PSS policies, NYC Aging requirements, contractual standards, and established program procedures.

  

The Program Coordinator does not have primary responsibility for program strategy, budget management, or overall program oversight, which remain with the Program Director.

  

This position reports to the Program Director, NY Connects

 **RESPONSIBILITIES:**

  

**Quality Assurance \& Accountability**


* Demonstrates strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
* Understands and applies quality assurance and compliance principles.
* Identifies documentation, data, and service\-delivery deficiencies.
* Follows through on corrective actions and quality improvement activities.
* Promotes a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.


**Data \& Performance Management**


* Ability to collect, organize, analyze, and interpret program data.
* Ability to monitor performance against established targets and deliverables.
* Maintains accurate and reliable program records.
* Identifies trends, discrepancies, and performance gaps.


**Organization \& Project Coordination**


* Effectively manages multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Develops and maintains organized tracking systems.
* Coordinates operational activities and follows through on assigned tasks.
* Demonstrates strong time\-management and organizational skills.


**Communication \& Collaboration**


* Communicates clearly and professionally with staff, management, community partners, and stakeholders.
* Provides constructive feedback regarding documentation and performance.
* Works collaboratively across program functions.
* Demonstrates strong interpersonal and problem\-solving skills.


**Professionalism \& Judgment**


* Exercises sound judgment and maintain confidentiality.
* Demonstrates reliability, initiative, and accountability.
* Appropriately escalates compliance, performance, and operational concerns.
* Maintains a person\-centered approach to service delivery


**Quality Assurance \& Compliance**


* Conduct routine reviews of client records, staff notes, assessments, referrals, and other program documentation.
* Ensure documentation is accurate, complete, timely, and consistent with program requirements.
* Identify documentation deficiencies and communicate required corrections to staff.
* Maintain QA tracking systems documenting findings, corrective actions, and resolution.
* Follow up to ensure identified deficiencies are addressed within established timeframes.
* Monitor staff adherence to program policies, procedures, documentation standards, and contractual requirements.
* Assist with preparation for internal audits, funder monitoring, site visits, and compliance reviews.
* Identify recurring quality and compliance concerns and recommend corrective measures.
* Escalate significant or unresolved compliance issues to the Program Director.
* Maintain organized documentation of QA activities for management and funder review.
* The role's QA responsibilities are designed to address the identified need for ongoing staff\-note reviews and QA documentation required by NYC Aging.


**Contractual Deliverables \& Performance Monitoring**


* Monitor program performance against contractual and programmatic requirements.
* Track Information and Assistance (IA), Outreach, Public Education, and other required program units.
* Maintain accurate systems for tracking productivity and contractual deliverables.
* Monitor progress toward established performance targets.
* Identify performance gaps and notify the Program Director of emerging concerns.
* Assist in developing strategies to address performance deficiencies.
* Verify that reported units are supported by appropriate documentation.
* Prepare routine performance reports and summaries.
* Maintain supporting documentation for contractual reporting.


**Data Management \& Integrity**


* Maintain program databases, spreadsheets, dashboards, and performance\-tracking systems.
* Monitor data\-entry practices and identify discrepancies or missing information.
* Review data for accuracy and completeness.
* Coordinate corrections to data discrepancies.
* Maintain accurate records of service activity, referrals, outreach, public education, and other deliverables.

While this role begins with a heavy focus on operations and administrative support, successful candidates will be integrated into account brainstorms and client projects as they master the agency's operational foundations.

* Identify opportunities to improve organization, workflows, and internal processes

**Client\-Ready Communication**

* Draft and support executive briefings, summaries, and presentations

**Social Media \& Digital Support**

* Support our internal and external brand presence on LinkedIn and Instagram, ensuring the FINN Travel and Maverick Creative voices remain at the forefront of the industry.

**Qualifications**

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About the role**
------------------


As an Account Manager at HUMAN, you will own and grow relationships with a portfolio of customers and partners. You will be responsible for customer experience, adoption, retention, renewals, and expansion across HUMAN’s solutions.


You will serve as a trusted advisor to key stakeholders, understand their business priorities, identify risks and opportunities, and translate customer needs into clear internal action. Success in this role requires a blend of relationship\-building, consultative selling, strategic thinking, commercial discipline, and hands\-on problem\-solving.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Build and maintain meaningful relationships with customer stakeholders and decision\-makers, serving as a primary point of contact and developing a strong understanding of their goals, business priorities, challenges, and experiences with HUMAN’s products and services.
* Drive product adoption by confidently sharing product knowledge, best practices, and recommendations that help customers realize value.
* Develop account strategies and actionable plans that increase customer value over time.
* Identify, prepare, and execute upsell and cross\-sell strategies that support customer outcomes and revenue growth.
* Lead renewal planning and facilitate seamless renewals by identifying risks early and coordinating the right internal resources.
* Identify and execute growth strategies that produce upsell and cross\-sell opportunities.
* Analyze account health, performance, engagement, and portfolio trends to identify growth opportunities, risks, and proactive next steps.
* Lead customer\-facing business reviews, strategic planning sessions, and presentations that clearly communicate performance, priorities, and recommendations.
* Partner with Product, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, Solutions, and technical teams to resolve issues, deliver strong customer outcomes, and act on customer feedback, market needs, and product or service gaps.
* Maintain strong pipeline discipline, account visibility, and timely reporting in Salesforce and other internal systems.
* Represent HUMAN at relevant industry events and use those interactions to strengthen customer relationships and bring market perspective back to customers and internal teams.
* Manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment while maintaining strong follow\-through and a high standard of customer care.

**Who you are**
---------------

* 8\+ years of experience in account management, partner development, consultative sales, or a closely related commercial role, with a track record of carrying and executing against a defined quota.
* Experience in ad tech, media, digital advertising, or a closely related technology ecosystem, with familiarity across relevant platforms and categories such as ad servers, SSPs, DSPs, exchanges, verification, fraud, and brand safety.
* A demonstrated ability to think strategically, identify business objectives and challenges, and translate them into compelling value propositions and action plans.
* A strong record of relationship\-building and consultative upselling and cross\-selling.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, negotiation, and executive communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with senior customer stakeholders and internal executives.
* Strong analytical judgment and the ability to use account context, customer data, and market knowledge to shape smart next steps.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills, a collaborative and solutions\-oriented approach, and the ability to operate with autonomy in a fast\-paced environment with some operational ambiguity.
* Strong organizational discipline, commercial judgment, and attention to detail.

**About HUMAN Security**


HUMAN was founded in a Brooklyn sci\-fi bookstore with a hacker mindset and the lofty mission of making the internet safer by putting humans first. Today, our Human Defense Platform safeguards enterprises from sophisticated bots, fraud, and account abuse, verifying the humanity of more than 20 trillion interactions per week for the world’s biggest brands and internet platforms.


HUMAN is an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to protecting the internet's integrity for everyone. We believe in putting people first, embracing diversity of thought from our global teams, and welcoming all individuals to share their unique experiences as we fight cybercrime together. We support our Humans with a comprehensive total rewards package for personal and professional development, including well\-being and learning stipends, flexible work options, and dedicated time off. While our HQ is in NYC, we have teams worldwide.


HUMAN is growing fast, and there’s never been a more meaningful time to join us. If you thrive on solving complex problems and want to help shape the future of cybersecurity, join us as we build a safer, more human internet.


If you are an individual with a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us directly.


Compensation Range: $120K \- $145K

jobs.title: Business Development Executive – Biotech Account Management - East Coast Remote
jobs.description:
**Work Schedule**


Standard (Mon\-Fri)**Environmental Conditions**


Office**Job Description**


When you are part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll do challenging work and be part of a team that values performance, quality and innovation. As part of a successful, growing global organization, you will be encouraged to perform at your best. With revenues of $40 billion and the largest investment in R\&D in the industry, we give our people the resources and opportunities to make significant contributions to the world.

**Location:** East Coast US\- Remote


As a **Business Development Executive** within our Pharma Services Biotech Account Management team, you will support the development and execution of territory and account plans to drive sales growth within your assigned accounts and prospect opportunities within your assigned territory across our broad range of drug modalities, which may include Steriles, Solid Dosage, Biologics, Cell Therapy, Viral Vector, and API.


In the role you will be responsible for implementing business strategies, annual marketing \& business plans, forecasting, providing marketing/competitive feedback and customer satisfaction relative to sales activities and profitable growth.


To be successful in the role you will need strong scientific and commercial acumen, be target\-focussed, and excel at building trusted relationships and demonstrating deep customer insight. You will also need strong customer relationship, communication and consultative selling skills, with the ability to identify opportunities and support customer success, data\-driven decision\-making, and resilience, alongside exceptional communication and the ability to work well in complex and competitive environments.

**A Day in the Life**

**Sales \& Business Development**

* Drive profitable growth and achieve/exceed AOP targets
* Secure new molecules, service expansions and increase share of wallet for existing biotech accounts
* Consultative selling through the full sales cycle from outreach to negotiation and contract execution
* Support the development and closure of commercial opportunities, quotations and contracts
* Identify and pursue opportunities within assigned accounts and prospects
* Create demand by aligning solutions to customer needs and pain points

**Territory \& Pipeline Management**

* Execute territory sales plans and contribute to territory growth objectives
* Build and maintain a strong, actionable pipeline
* Identify and maximise opportunities within existing accounts
* Maintain accurate forecasting and SFDC discipline

**Customer \& Market Leadership**

* Build and maintain effective relationships with customer stakeholders across assigned accounts
* Understand customer structures, decision\-makers, and industry trends
* Communicate Thermo Fisher’s value as an integrated solutions partner
* Monitor competitive activity and adapt strategies to mitigate threats

**Collaboration \& Customer Experience**

* Have a global mindset and partner cross\-functionally (SMEs, operations, finance, legal) to deliver solutions
* Participate in customer meetings, events, and site visits to support business development activities
* Champion customer experience proactively with urgency, integrity, and accountability
* Provide feedback to improve customer experience and internal processes
* Collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders to support customer needs and sales objectives

**Key Requirements**

* 3\-5 years of quota\-carrying field sales or business development experience
* Previous sales, deal design and relationship management experience essential
* Experience of sales within a CDMO, and in one or more of our current drug modalities (Steriles, Solid Dosage, Biologics, Cell Therapy, Viral Vector, and API) will be a distinct advantage
* Strong analytical skills including financial competence
* Strong relationship\-building skills with customers and internal stakeholders
* Experience managing sales opportunities and customer relationships within a matrix environment
* Experience progressing opportunities through a consultative sales process
* Strong commercial acumen with experience shaping solutions and influencing deal outcomes
* Confident communicator with executive presence and strong negotiation skills
* Highly competitive, self\-directed, and results\-driven mindset
* Comfortable operating with urgency, ambiguity, and limited structure
* Willingness to travel up to 50 percent to meet customers and showcase Thermo Fisher sites

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in a Life Sciences field required

**Why This Role Is Distinct**


Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer.


As one team of 100,000\+ colleagues, we share a common set of values — Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement — working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need.


\#StartYourStory at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.


Apply today! http://jobs.thermofisher.com

**Compensation and Benefits**


The salary range estimated for this position based in Massachusetts is $102,200\.00–$153,350\.00\.
This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes:

* A choice of national medical and dental plans, and a national vision plan, including health incentive programs
* Employee assistance and family support programs, including commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement
* At least 120 hours paid time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays annually, paid parental leave (3 weeks for bonding and 8 weeks for caregiver leave), accident and life insurance, and short\- and long\-term disability in

jobs.description:

 **Role Summary:**


Medscape is looking for an experienced **Account Manager** who will be responsible for the overall client satisfaction and programme delivery for assigned Medscape Medical Affairs accounts. The Account Manager is the primary relationship owner and serves as the project manager for all deliverables. The Account Manager is responsible for defining client performance, evaluating the effectiveness of client programmes, and recommending improvements or additional services as appropriate.


The candidate will be expected to manage and execute a range of projects across multiple departments in support of our Medical Affairs business. The applicant should be a highly organized individual with strong account leadership and customer relationship management expertise, detailed and clear communication skills, and a proven ability to prioritize and excel in a deadline\-driven environment, with a particular focus on efficient project and timeline execution.

**Responsibilities:**

* Member of a broader account team supporting project execution across a range of clients, which can include project kick\-off, development and updates, metric reports
* Building and maintaining strong relationships with various internal stakeholders (ie. Marketing, Product Development, Audience Generation, Content Development, Outcomes and Insights) that will assist in smooth and on\-time project execution and impact future business by communicating client needs and expectations
* Manage timelines for digital programs for efficient and on time delivery
* Assisting in the development and maintenance of business relationships with current and prospective pharmaceutical, medical device and other clients in conjunction with sales colleagues as appropriate, including the ability to translate client priorities and expectations clearly across internal development teams
* Staying abreast of overall project implementation across all external and internal development teams including use of an electronic task management system
* Able to implement processes and procedures; managing the project scope and timeline
* Working with other departments to streamline processes to allow for efficient timelines; Communicating client needs and expectations clearly across development teams
* Able to effectively trouble shoot and find solutions to meet client’s and internal stakeholders’ expectations
* Time permitting, staying abreast of client news, market conditions, competitive activities, educational and technological trends through ongoing research and engagement at industry and medical conferences, literature reviews and other sources
* Align client programme objectives and project timelines as part of start\-up process
* Implement programmes to meet client objectives
* Deliver and discuss reporting

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelors’ Degree required
* Minimum of 3 years of account management and/or project management experience in a digital / healthcare agency setting.
* Ability to efficiently coordinate and work on multiple tasks simultaneously in a highly deadline\-driven environment
* Very strong customer service orientation
* Excellent time management, organizational skills and the ability to prioritize in order to meet deadlines
* Work in a cohesive team environment as well as independently
* Self\-motivated, positive attitude, with a willingness to accept varied assignments
* Extreme focus on accuracy, attention to detail and consistency of work
* Excellent communication (verbal and written) skills
* Knowledge of medical terminology and/or experience in medical publishing, or agency environment, or relevant digital technologies
* Experience with web\-based document sharing sites (such as Google and SharePoint Online)
* Excellent organization and documentation skills (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, task management systems like Workfront, Salesforce and the ability to master internal systems such as JIRA, training tools such as Brainshark and Accent Librarian)
* Occasional travel

**Salary range:** $75,000 \- $80,000

jobs.title: Intermediary Account Manager - Growth Markets
jobs.description:
PIMCO is a global leader in active fixed income with deep expertise across public and private markets. We invest our clients’ capital across a range of fixed income and credit opportunities, leveraging our decades of experience navigating complex debt markets. Our flexible capital base and deep relationships with issuers have helped us become one of the world’s largest providers of traditional and nontraditional solutions for companies that need financing and investors who seek strong risk\-adjusted returns.


Since 1971, our people have shaped our organization through a high\-performance inclusive culture, in which we celebrate diverse thinking. We invest in our people and strive to imprint our CORE values of Collaboration, Openness, Responsibility and Excellence. We believe each of us is here to help others succeed and this has led to PIMCO being recognized as an innovator, industry thought leader and trusted advisor to our clients.


PIMCO's success as a global investment solutions provider is driven by the talent, dedication and entrepreneurial spirit of our people.


PIMCO is seeking an experienced Account Manager to help expand our Separately Managed Account (SMA) business and deepen relationships with leading advisory clients.

**Mission:**


Deliver exceptional sales, service and investment support to PIMCO's largest advisory clients while helping accelerate the growth of our SMA platform. In this highly visible role, you will combine fixed income market expertise, portfolio insight and relationship management to create meaningful outcomes for clients and the business.

**What you'll do:**

* Stay closely connected to financial markets, the global economic environment, asset allocation, investment vehicles and developments across the financial services industry
* Build trusted client relationships through substantive interactions by phone, email, screen sharing and in\-person meetings, including territory travel, industry conferences and due diligence engagements
* Translate portfolio analysis and market developments into clear, relevant commentary for clients, prospects and internal partners
* Partner with PIMCO Account Managers to position, sell and support municipal and taxable investment offerings
* Advance sales efforts by reviewing trends, analyzing portfolios and developing client\-ready reports and insights
* Develop a strong understanding of each client's business model, priorities and evolving needs to deliver tailored support
* Provide timely marketing perspective, product information, investment ideas and sales support with confidence and credibility
* Take ownership of designated client segments, with the autonomy to identify opportunities, shape strategy and drive growth

**Position Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree from an accredited four\-year institution; concentrations in finance, economics, mathematics, computer science or a related field are valued
* 10\+ years of relevant experience in the asset management or wealth management industry
* A compelling communicator who can make complex investment concepts clear, relevant and actionable
* Strong knowledge of PIMCO, or the ability and motivation to quickly learn PIMCO's investment platform, processes and culture
* A goal\-oriented mindset, sound judgment and a consistent record of following through on commitments
* Excellent interpersonal skills and a genuine interest in understanding clients, colleagues and their priorities
* A collaborative approach, combined with the initiative and confidence to lead projects independently
* Demonstrated strength in building and sustaining long\-term relationships
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Intellectual curiosity and a desire to continuously deepen market, product and client knowledge
* Enthusiasm for contributing to a rapidly growing business and helping shape its next phase
* Willingness to travel 25\-50% of the time
* FINRA Series 7 and 63 licenses
* CFA designation and/or MBA is a plus
* Experience working with key partners in the SMA ecosystem is preferred


PIMCO follows a total compensation approach when rewarding employees which includes a base salary and a discretionary bonus. Base salary is the fixed component of compensation that is determined by core job responsibilities, relevant experience, internal level, and market factors. The discretionary bonus is used to award performance and therefore is determined by company, business, team, and individual performance.

jobs.description:
* New York, New York
* Regular Employee Full\-Time
* R\-2026\-09\-23
* Hybrid


  
**Who We Are:**


SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad\-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners \- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.


This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically\-acclaimed, industry\-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.


**SiriusXM** is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising\-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad\-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SiriusXM Media, leverages its scale, cross\-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.


**How you’ll make an impact:**


The Marketing Specialist, Aviation \& Marine Services, plays a key role in owning and executing defined marketing initiatives that drive brand awareness, engagement, and subscriber growth for SiriusXM’s Aviation and Marine lines of business. This role combines creativity with analytical rigor to execute marketing initiatives, coordinate partnerships, and evaluate campaign performance within established processes and guidelines. The Marketing Specialist supports a wide range of activities from social media management to video production, digital campaigns, event marketing, and more.


**What you’ll do:**

* Develop and manage social media content calendars for SiriusXM Aviation and Marine brands across Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube.
* Schedule and publish content while monitoring engagement, responding to comments, refining strategies based on analytics, and determining appropriate routine adjustments within established marketing guidelines.
* Keep up to date on current social media practices to identify new ideas and content that will increase engagement with our target audiences.
* Assist in filming marketing videos, including setup, interviews, and capturing b\-roll.
* Collaborate on creative assets such as emails, brochures, digital and print ads, and podcasts.
* Support website updates and coordinate with SiriusXM’s .com team and external vendors.
* Conduct monthly analysis and reporting for organic and paid search, digital advertising, social media, and email marketing; evaluate performance across channels, identify trends, and recommend actions based on multiple data points.
* Manage the production, updates, and ordering of printed materials and merchandise.
* Assist with communications with Aviation \& Marine influencers and brand ambassadors, including reviewing annual contracts.
* Own project coordination for defined marketing initiatives and events, including boat shows, airshows, and tournaments, applying independent judgment to keep deliverables on schedule and within budget.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with internal stakeholders – including Legal, Brand, Finance, DE, and Operations \- and external partners to ensure marketing consistency and brand alignment, building productive internal and external working relationships.
* Manage onboarding of new external paid search agency including contract process.
* Maintain expertise with internal systems including promotion approvals, customer care, billing, and contracts.

**What you’ll need:**


* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum of 2 years of related experience; or an advanced degree without experience; or equivalent work experience.
* Ability to travel to select events and partner meetings within the U.S.
* Strong organizational and project management skills with attention to detail.
* Ability to prioritize information and tasks by urgent vs. less time\-sensitive and critical vs. non\-critical.
* Consistent follow\-through to completion of tasks and activities – to ensure prioritized activities are completed on schedule and within budget.
* Experience managing vendor and partner relationships.
* Proven interpersonal skills – able to work effectively and develop relationships with key contacts across functions internally and at partner organizations as needed.
* Listens well – not only in meetings, but also open to coaching for professional development.
* Positive attitude and flexible – willing and able to perform other duties as necessary for team success.
* Able to work independentlyon routine assignments with general direction and appropriately seek input and approvals on new projects or assignments.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency with MS O

JPMorganChase AI Research (AIR) is a global team of research scientists, engineers and product managers that develops novel AI capabilities and partners across the firm to translate breakthrough AI/ML techniques into deployed solutions. The team brings together researchers across multi\-agent systems, foundation model training, reinforcement and continual learning, multimodal document AI, formal reasoning, planning and verification, and synthetic data generation – alongside experts in trustworthy AI, privacy, and cryptography – to solve hard problems end\-to\-end in ways that are secure, reliable, and scalable in financial services.


AI Research sits within the Chief Data \& Analytics Office (CDAO) at JPMorganChase which is responsible for accelerating the firm's data and analytics journey. This includes ensuring the quality, integrity, and security of the firm's data, as well as leveraging this data to generate insights and drive decision\-making. The CDAO is also responsible for developing and implementing solutions that support the firm's commercial goals by harnessing artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies to develop new products, improve productivity, and enhance risk management, effectively and responsibly.

You will shape how the team plans, invests, executes, and scales – aligning talent, capital, and infrastructure behind a bold research agenda. * Champion responsible AI governance and a balanced application of controls – enabling the team to move fast, take smart risks, and innovate within a strong risk and compliance posture.

jobs.description:
### **Position**

Loro Piana is an Italian luxury Maison founded in 1924, known for creating the finest quality textiles, ready\-to\-wear collections, accessories, and bespoke garments. Our dedication to exceptional craftsmanship and use of the world’s finest raw materials positions us a leader in the luxury industry. As an iconic Maison within the LVMH group, we uphold a strong commitment to unparalleled quality and excellence.  



General Purpose of the Position:


We are seeking a Seasonal Operations Specialist to join our team at Loro Piana. The Operations Specialist plays a pivotal role in the overall success of the business by supporting all operational and inventory\-related activities. You will be responsible for managing incoming and outgoing shipments, replenishing products on the sales floor, and organizing inventory to maximize efficiency. You will collaborate with all members of the team to ensure that stockroom conditions align with Loro Piana standards, contributing to seamless store operations.


### **Job responsibilities**

Key Responsibilities


* Optimize inventory flow and streamline operational processes while handling the accurate processing of shipments and transfers.
* Oversee the movement of merchandise from the stockroom to the sales floor and maintain appropriate inventory levels to align with sales potential.
* Conduct cycle counts as per corporate calendar to verify product quantities and report discrepancies in a timely manner. Perform regular audits to verify product conditions.
* Facilitate the implementation of security measures through inspections, audits, and preparing products for display.
* Ensure ongoing inventory organization according to company procedures and establish an optimized warehouse layout for improved accessibility by the sales team.
* Maintain clean, neat, and organized stock rooms with proper labeling to facilitate sales.
* Maintain effective communication with the operations team and external couriers to ensure accurate shipping procedures and timely delivery.
Provide the sales team with detailed updates regarding inventory availability to support the sales process and enhance sales performance.  
* 
### **Profile**

Skills and Abilities Required


* 3\+ years of operational and inventory experience, preferably in a luxury retail environment.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, SAP, and other digital tools.
* Excellent communication, teamwork, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong knowledge of operations and inventory control.
* Ability to lift and move objects up to 40 pounds.
### **Additional information**

What we offer


At Loro Piana, we believe in fostering a supportive and rewarding work environment that values our employees' well\-being and growth. We offer a comprehensive range of benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage, fertility support, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, tuition reimbursement, 401K match, and Headspace mental health support. Additionally, employees enjoy a generous product discount, exclusive LVMH discounts, and other tailored perks.

Loro Piana uses the published salary range as a guideline to provide our employees with market\-competitive pay while allowing for flexibility to recognize and reward various levels of expertise, performance, and tenure.
  

  

While the published salary range is a good faith reflection of the targeted salary level for the position, Loro Piana reserves the right to pay outside of the published salary range of $24 to $26 USD per hour.
  

  

EEO Statement


We strive to create a culture of inclusion where everyone has a sense of belonging. Our goal is to ensure that our outreach and recruiting efforts generate diverse identities and perspectives that will be valued and can thrive. We are continuously assessing our employee and candidate populations to identify ways to ensure they are all\-encompassing and equitable.


***LORO PIANA***
**MAISON**
---------------------------

Originally from Trivero in northern Italy, the Loro Piana family began trading wool in the early 1800s. In 1924, Pietro Loro Piana founded Ing. Loro Piana \& C., the current company. Pietro’s nephew Franco took over in 1941, and after the war the firm began to establish its reputation as a supplier of premium wool and cashmere textiles for a growing haute couture industry, both home and abroad. In the 1970s, Sergio and Pier Luigi Loro Piana took up the reins, diversifying into luxury goods and developing an international retail arm. Now the world’s foremost cashmere processor, Loro Piana prides itself on sourcing the very finest, rarest raw materials the world has to offer, including unique cashmere from baby goats in northern China and Mongolia, vicuña from the Andes, extra\-fine Merino wool from Australia and New Zealand and lotus flower fiber from Myanmar. The company draws on both time\-honored traditions and state of the art technology to offer its discerning customers products that are renowned for their peerless quality. All of the company’s collections of ready\-to\-wear garments and accessories are made in Italy to the highest standards of craftsmanship and sartorial excellence.

Hemophilia of Georgia, Inc.  

Job Description
Position: Grants Program Coordinator Status: Exempt
Supervisor: Senior Director of Policy \& Compliance Work Location: Hybrid Travel: 15% international
Funding: Funding for this position is provided through program (PHS) resources within the organization.
  

Hemophilia of Georgia (HoG) is a nationally and internationally recognized nonprofit organization that provides programs and support services for people with hemophilia, von Willebrand Disease, and other bleeding disorders. HoG is the only agency of its kind in the state and is dedicated to enhancing the health and wellness of the bleeding disorder community by providing excellence in comprehensive health care, education, advocacy, and the support of research to transform lives.
  

Commitment to HoG Culture:  

* Maintain a positive work atmosphere by acting and communicating in a manner so that you work productively, effectively, and efficiently with customers, clients, co\-workers, and management.

  

* Hemophilia of Georgia operates an annual summer camp program for children and teens with hemophilia and other inherited bleeding disorders. Camp is typically held in the summer (which may include the Fourth of July) and runs Saturday\-Friday, and the date changes each year. Camp is an agency\-wide, strategic priority; therefore, all exempt employees must participate. Assignments may include duties at camp, helping campers get to and from camp, and may involve overnight travel. The Director of Camp \& Client Events will provide advance notice to exempt employees of where support is needed. PTO requests during the week of camp are generally not approved; however, PTO requests for extenuating circumstances will be reviewed on a case\-by\-case basis by the Chief Community Engagement Officer.

  

Position Summary
The Grants Management Coordinator provides administrative, programmatic, and operational support for HoG's domestic and international grants, cooperative agreements, or other grant\-funded activities. This role serves as a key liaison with external partners and stakeholders, helping ensure effective communication, collaboration, and the successful implementation of grants, cooperative agreements, or other programs that advance the organization's mission. The Coordinator manages the full grant lifecycle, including coordinating Requests for Proposals (RFPs), administering the grant submission platform, tracking budgets and deliverables, maintaining grant records, ensuring compliance with grant requirements, and supporting reporting, data collection, and program documentation. Domestic and international travel is required to support program implementation, monitor grant activities, and support organizational goals.
  

Qualifications:
  

Required Qualifications  

* Bachelor’s degree in Public Health, Public Administration, Nonprofit Management, or a related field.
* 2 to 5 years of experience in nonprofit operations, grant writing, administrative coordination, or compliance support.
* Exceptional English writing, editing, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to craft clear and persuasive proposals and reports.
* Strong project management, organizational, and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and Word, including budgeting and financial tracking.
* Experience using grant management, CRM, and reporting systems.
* Ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
* Strong cross\-cultural communication, relationship\-building, and diplomatic skills.

  

Essential Functions:  

* Manage the full grant lifecycle, including award administration, compliance monitoring, partner deliverables, budget oversight, and reporting requirements of HoG non\-federal grants and cooperative agreements.
* Lead the development of high\-quality grant proposals, project narratives, logical frameworks, budgets, and other funding applications in collaboration with executive leadership.
* Monitor project implementation and expenditures to ensure alignment with funding requirements, federal regulations, organizational policies, and approved project plans.
* Prepare, compile, and review narrative, financial, statistical, and operational reports for internal leadership.
* Maintain accurate grant records, tracking systems, databases, award documentation, reporting schedules, and communication logs.
* Serving as liaison between the organization and external customers, recipients, and awardee community to clarify, interpret, and resolve issues
* Evaluate the effectiveness of grants management systems and processes; conduct analyses and recommend improvements to strengthen compliance, efficiency, and program performance.
* Collaborate with executive leadership to develop, implement, interpret, and continuously improve grant management policies, procedures, and operational practices.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for HoG’s international grants and cooperative agreements through project execution and building relationships with funding partners
* Implement the planning, execution, monitoring, and evaluation of international grant\-funded projects and cooperative agreements.
* Monitor project implementation, track spending, reconcile accounts, and manage budget revisions for international projects.
* Foster collaborations to leverage resources, expertise, and networks.

  

Additional Responsibilities:  

* Additional duties as assigned by the Chief Policy \& Compliance Officer

jobs.title: Executive Assistant & Business Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Executive Assistant \& Business Operations Coordinator**



As the **Executive Assistant \& Business Operations Coordinator**, you will play a key role in supporting the company’s legal, regulatory, and executive functions. You’ll manage corporate entities, licenses, permits, compliance deadlines, and acquisition\-related activities while providing high\-level administrative support to the President and senior leadership. This role is ideal for a highly organized, discreet, technology\-forward professional who can manage competing priorities, build strong relationships across the organization, and use technology and AI to streamline processes and support a growing company.


**What You’ll Be Doing**


* You will manage the lifecycle of corporate legal entities, including formations, registrations, annual renewals, filings, maintenance, and dissolutions across multiple states and jurisdictions.
* You will oversee liquor licenses, business licenses, food service licenses, hotel licenses, permits, and other regulatory requirements across the company’s properties and locations.
* You will maintain compliance calendars, licensing records, corporate documentation, and audit\-ready files while proactively tracking deadlines and renewals.
* You will coordinate with outside legal counsel, registered agents, government agencies, Accounting, Operations, Human Resources, Business Development, and property leadership to ensure compliance requirements are completed accurately and on time.
* You will support new acquisitions, management takeovers, property openings, and transitions by coordinating entity formations, EINs, state registrations, licenses, permits, and required documentation.
* You will assist with due diligence, M\&A activities, financing, audits, and other legal and corporate projects as needed.
* You will maintain corporate governance records, including organizational documents, resolutions, minute books, cap tables, and organizational charts.
* You will manage the transfer, renewal, and closure of licenses associated with property openings, ownership changes, property sales, and entity dissolutions.
* You will support brand and investor administration, including employee ID setups, annual investor tax document distribution, and maintaining accurate property and business unit records.
* You will serve as a company notary public for corporate and legal documents.
* You will use technology, automation, and AI tools to improve compliance tracking, document management, renewal processes, and recurring administrative workflows.
* You will manage complex calendars, travel arrangements, meetings, correspondence, expenses, and other administrative responsibilities for the President and senior leadership team.
* You will coordinate executive meetings, offsites, and board meetings, including logistics, materials, follow\-up items, and communication.
* You will serve as a trusted liaison between the President’s office, internal departments, external partners, board members, and other key stakeholders.
* You will handle confidential legal, financial, executive, and personal information with a high level of discretion and professionalism.
* You will continuously identify opportunities to improve processes, automate recurring work, and create scalable systems as the organization continues to grow.


**Education \& Experience**


* Paralegal certificate, degree, or equivalent professional experience in corporate or legal compliance.
* Three (3\) or more years of experience managing corporate compliance, licensing, regulatory filings, or related legal administration.
* Hospitality, restaurant, alcohol beverage, multi\-state real estate, or franchise industry experience, highly preferred.
* Experience managing multi\-state business licenses and/or liquor licenses.
* Experience supporting C\-suite executives in a fast\-paced environment.
* Familiarity with state Secretary of State filing systems and Alcohol Beverage Control (ABC) processes.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and document management platforms such as SharePoint.
* Experience navigating state, county, and municipal filing portals.
* Hands\-on experience using AI or automation tools to streamline legal, compliance, administrative, or document\-management processes.
* Active notary public commission, or willingness to obtain one shortly after hire.


**Essentials**



To be a successful candidate, you will need the following:


* Eligible to work in the United States.
* Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage a high volume of recurring deadlines across multiple states, entities, properties, and executives.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain accurate records and documentation.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership, outside counsel, government agencies, and property teams.
* High degree of discretion and professionalism when handling confidential legal, financial, executive, and personal information.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills with the ability to exercise sound judgment and adapt to changing priorities.
* Ability to build collaborative relationships and work effectively across multiple departments while balancing competing priorities.
* Technology\-forward mindset with the ability and willingness to use AI, automation, and digital tools to improve efficiency.
* Ability to embrace HVMG’s Culture of Excellence by demonstrating professionalism, a positive attitude, and a commitment to exceptional service.
* Amazing opportunities for career advancement across HVMG
* Flexible PTO
* Up to 40% earned wages paid BEFORE payday with PayActive
* Full Healthcare Benefits (including medical, dental, and vision coverage)
* 401k Retirement Plan with a guaranteed 4% match and no vesting
* Hotel and Food and Beverage Discounts and Perks


**Careers at HVMG**

Our **Be Excellent culture** is more than just words

jobs.title: Youth Development Coordinator

**Serving California, Pennsylvania, Florida, and Texas**

  


**ABOUT THE ROLE**

  


As part of the America’s team, SANY is looking to recruit a driven, forward\-thinking, and highly motivated **Key Account Manager**. Critical to this growth is the appointment of a high\-quality **Key Account Manager**. This position will be responsible for developing and executing national account strategies, identifying new business opportunities, expanding SANY's presence within key accounts, and building long\-term partnerships that increase equipment sales and market share.



The ideal candidate is a highly motivated, relationship\-driven sales professional with demonstrated success selling heavy equipment, construction equipment, rental equipment, or other capital equipment to large national or multi\-location customers.

  



With current revenues over $500 million, SANY America continues to make strong progress and significant investments in the Americas market; the organization is now pursuing an aggressive growth strategy and is looking to move quickly beyond this initial platform and increase market share.

REMOTE (FULLY REMOTE)

Frequent (50%\+)

jobs.description:
Job Description

**Job Code:** SOOS03

**Job Family:** Sales Representative: Sales Account Management

**Location: East Coast**

**Compensation: $120K \-$200K**

**Job Description**


The Heidelberg Sales Account Manager, Labels, is responsible for developing and maintaining strong relationships with existing and prospective customers within an assigned territory covering East Coast. This position specializes in the Gallus portfolio of label printing and converting solutions, including digital and flexographic label presses, workflow software, inspection systems, and related consumables.


As a consultative sales professional, the Sales Account Manager works closely with label converters, packaging printers, and brand\-focused manufacturing organizations to understand their production requirements, operational challenges, and growth objectives. By leveraging technical knowledge of label manufacturing processes and Heidelberg's label production technologies, the individual develops customized solutions that improve productivity, print quality, automation, and profitability.


The Sales Account Manager \- Labels serves as a trusted advisor throughout the equipment investment lifecycle, guiding customers through equipment evaluations, workflow assessments, ROI analysis, capital equipment purchasing decisions, installation planning, and long\-term partnership development. This role bridges the gap between technical production capabilities and customers' business goals, helping organizations remain competitive in the evolving label and packaging marketplace.

 **Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Identify and qualify prospective label converters, packaging printers, commercial printers entering the label market, and other target customers within the assigned territory through networking, prospecting, industry research, trade shows, digital resources and working collaboratively with the Heidelberg/Gallus sales team.
* Develop and maintain strong, long\-term customer relationships by understanding label production workflows, business objectives, operational challenges, and future growth plans.
* Promote the Gallus portfolio of label solutions, including digital and flexographic label presses, workflow automation solutions, inspection technologies, and ancillary production equipment.
* Conduct comprehensive needs assessments and production evaluations to recommend equipment, software, and workflow solutions that improve operational efficiency and profitability.
* Serve as a trusted advisor by providing application expertise, market insights, and recommendations tailored to customer\-specific label and packaging production requirements.
* Develop and execute territory business plans and strategic account plans targeting key label converters and growth opportunities.
* Achieve or exceed annual sales objectives for label presses, equipment upgrades, software solutions, service agreements, and related product offerings.
* Build and maintain a robust sales pipeline utilizing Heidelberg's CRM platform and sales management processes.
* Prepare and deliver compelling presentations, equipment demonstrations, ROI analyses, and business proposals to executive, operational, and production stakeholders.
* Coordinate resources across sales, product management, applications, service, and executive leadership teams to support complex capital equipment sales opportunities.
* Act as the primary customer contact throughout the sales process, ensuring a seamless experience from prospecting through installation and post\-sale follow\-up.
* Conduct regular customer visits in accordance with territory coverage plans to maintain market visibility and identify new opportunities.
* Negotiate pricing, terms, and contracts in alignment with company policies and approved discount structures.
* Maintain current knowledge of industry trends, competitive technologies, market developments, and Heidelberg label solutions.
* Provide accurate forecasting, opportunity tracking, and pipeline reporting through Heidelberg's CRM and sales reporting systems.
* Represent Heidelberg at trade shows, customer events, industry conferences, and association meetings related to the label and packaging industry.

 **Qualifications and Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Printing Technology, Engineering, or related field preferred.
* Minimum 3\-5 years of business\-to\-business sales experience, preferably within the printing, label, packaging, converting, or capital equipment industries.
* Experience selling capital equipment, production technologies, workflow software, or manufacturing solutions preferred.
* Knowledge of label printing processes, digital printing technologies, flexographic printing, converting equipment, or packaging production is highly desirable.
* Ability to acquire and maintain detailed technical and application knowledge of Gallus label products and solutions.
* Strong consultative selling, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Demonstrated success in managing complex sales cycles involving multiple decision makers.
* Goal\-oriented and driven to consistently achieve sales targets and business objectives.
* Strong understanding and disciplined execution of the full sales process from prospecting through closing and post\-sale account management.
* Technical aptitude with the ability to discuss production requirements, equipment specifications, workflow efficiencies, and business outcomes with production managers and technical personnel.
* Strong verbal, written, and presentation communication skills.
* Professional demeanor with the ability to establish credibility and confidence with customers and stakeholders.
* Proficient with CRM systems, Microsoft Office Suite, and virtual presentation tools.
* Willingness to travel extensively throughout the assigned territory.

 **Key Competencies**

* Consultative Selling
* Territory Management
* Capital Equipment Sales
* Label and Packaging In

* Ability to efficiently coordinate and work on multiple tasks simultaneously in a highly deadline\-driven environment
* Very strong customer service orientation
* Excellent time management, organizational skills and the ability to prioritize in order to meet deadlines

**Bonus Eligible:** This position is also eligible for a discretionary company bonus, based upon business results.

* Paid Time Off (including vacation, sick leave, and flexible holiday days)
* 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer matching
* Life and Disability Insurance
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

At Wheels, we’re shaping the future of mobility by delivering experiences our customers love and moving businesses forward through passionate people and creative solutions. As an Associate Account Manager, you’ll be part of that journey supporting the teams and clients who make it possible.


This highly visible role sits within our Client Services organization and is designed as a developmental position providing the foundation to grow into a future Account Manager. You’ll work alongside Account Managers, Fleet Consulting Executives, and key operational teams to ensure clients receive the highest level of service and support.


Your work will contribute directly to 100% client retention by ensuring continuity, accuracy, and responsiveness across a shared account portfolio. From managing inquiries and executing transactions to preparing reports, conducting research, and providing analytical and administrative support, you’ll help deliver the quality and consistency our clients expect even in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.


Success in this role requires curiosity, attention to detail, and a strong sense of ownership. * Intermediate to Advanced Proficiency in Microsoft Excel
* Salesforce experience preferred

* **Integrity** – Always act with integrity and honesty.
* **One Team** – Treat others with dignity and respect; act as a cohesive, inclusive and accountable team that is making a difference.

* **Customer Success** – Ensure that customer and driver success is at the heart of everything we do.

* Partner with internal teams (sales operations, supply chain, finance, marketing) to ensure execution of customer programs
* Track and follow up on action items, timelines, and deliverables
* Maintain accurate account records, forecasts, and customer data

* 1–3 years of experience supporting retail accounts, sales, or account management (CPG experience preferred)
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to interpret data
* Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; exposure to syndicated data (IRI/Nielsen) is a plus
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to work both independently and in a team\-oriented environment
* Willingness to travel as needed

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with grocery or retail accounts
* Familiarity with promotional planning and retail execution
* Strong desire to grow into a Key Account Manager role
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) is a plus, but not required

**Location Alignment**

*East Coast Region:*

Overview:

Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity.  

  

With 5,400\+ employees and over 80,000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq\-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world\-class products and services to all types of investors.  

  

Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth.

 **Business Segment Overview:**

**Commercial**: With boots on the ground authenticity at the heart of everything we do, our comprehensive array of commercial products and services enable you to work directly with our clients, across hedging, risk management, execution and clearing, OTC products, commodity finance and more.

  



**Position purpose:** StoneX Commodity Solutions LLC is part of StoneX Group Inc., a global financial services network that connects clients to markets across commodities, risk management, and physical supply. Our SCS Specialty Coffee team provides green coffee sourcing, sales, trade execution, and risk\-management solutions to roasters, importers, and specialty coffee partners.

  

This is a dual\-focus position that blends front\-line customer relationship management with behind\-the\-scenes trade and operations support. The Customer Success Associate / Trade Assistant is the connective tissue of the desk — keeping customers informed and supported while ensuring trades, contracts, and logistics run smoothly from execution through delivery. It is an ideal opportunity for an organized, detail\-oriented professional who wants exposure to both the commercial and operational sides of the specialty coffee trade.

  

Reporting to the Senior Vice President, SCS Specialty Coffee, this role serves as a primary day\-to\-day contact for customers and as a core support resource for the sales and trading team. On the customer success side, you will own the post\-sale relationship — onboarding accounts, coordinating samples, communicating order and shipment status, and resolving issues. On the trade\-assistant side, you will support contract administration, position tracking, logistics coordination, and trade documentation. Success in this role means customers feel well cared for and the desk’s trades and records are accurate, timely, and audit\-ready.

 ***Note on role design:*** *This role is currently structured as a single, combined position covering both customer success and trade\-assistant responsibilities (approximately a 50/50 split). * Monitor contract execution milestones such as shipment, first\-notice/quality steps, grading, and arrival.
