You'll be the engine behind outbound prospecting into asset\-intensive enterprises, opening conversations with senior finance and IT leaders, qualifying opportunities, and booking discovery calls that free our Strategic Account Executives to focus on closing.  

This role comes with a defined career progression path mapped out at approximately the 18\-month mark, a full sales tech stack on day one, and finalized ICP and buyer personas before you start. It's the right seat for someone early in their sales career who wants to learn enterprise software sales from the inside, build a foundation in a complex B2B market, and grow into a closing role.
Responsibilities:

Success will be measured by how fast you ramp to full outbound activity, how consistently you hit your outreach targets, and by the quality — not just the volume — of the meetings you hand off to Strategic AEs.* Complete structured onboarding and earn messaging certification within your first 60 days, ramping to full outbound activity targets.
* Execute a high\-volume, multi\-channel outbound motion — cold calling, cold email, and LinkedIn\-led social selling — targeting buying committees within PowerPlan's ideal customer profile.
* Hit weekly and monthly activity targets for outbound calls, emails, and meaningful conversations, and log every interaction in Salesforce same\-day.
* Qualify every inbound and outbound lead against BANT criteria and PowerPlan's ICP before booking a discovery call.
* Hand off qualified meetings to Strategic AEs with clean, complete context — account background, contact details, the pain or trigger behind the conversation, and relevant CRM history.
* Report back to Marketing Ops on lead source strength, messaging effectiveness, and objection patterns, and partner with Strategic AEs on coordinated outbound into named accounts.

* 1\-2 years in a sales, business development, or customer\-facing role (strong candidates with 0\-1 years will be considered).

* Exceptional verbal and written communication — able to hold a credible business conversation with a senior finance or IT leader.

* Working proficiency with Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, sales intelligence tools (Ample Market or equivalent), and spreadsheets.
* Resilient and goal\-oriented — high tolerance for rejection and the ability to stay consistent in high\-volume outreach over time.
* Curious and coachable — acts on feedback fast and applies lessons from every conversation to the next one.

jobs.title: Event Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Event Operations Manager

**Location:** Oak Brook, IL (Office) \| Chicagoland Event Venues

**Primary Event Locations:** McCormick Place (Chicago) and Donald E. Stephens Convention Center (Rosemont)

**Job Type:** Full\-Time

**Salary:** $50,000\-$60,000 per year

Join the AF Services Team

AF Services is a leading provider of event staffing, guest services, and event operations throughout the Chicagoland area. We partner with premier convention centers, trade shows, corporate events, sporting events, and special events to deliver exceptional service and operational excellence.

We're looking for an experienced, motivated leader to join our Operations team. This is a hands\-on management position for someone who thrives in fast\-paced environments, enjoys leading people, and takes pride in delivering outstanding service to clients.

**The majority of this role is spent managing live events onsite.** You'll oversee operations at some of the Midwest's largest convention and event venues, working directly with clients and leading teams to ensure every event is executed successfully.

When you're not onsite at events, you'll work from our **Oak Brook office** assisting with recruiting, scheduling, employee compliance, and operational planning.

If you enjoy the excitement of live events and no two days being the same, we'd love to meet you.

What You'll DoEvent Operations

· Serve as the onsite Event Operations Manager for conventions, trade shows, sporting events, and special events throughout the Chicagoland area.

· Manage event operations primarily at McCormick Place in Chicago and the Donald E. Stephens Convention Center in Rosemont, with additional assignments at other Chicagoland venues.

· Lead, supervise, and support large teams of event personnel before, during, and after events.

· Conduct pre\-event walkthroughs and coordinate logistics with clients, venue representatives, and internal staff.

· Serve as the primary onsite point of contact for clients.

· Resolve operational challenges quickly while maintaining a calm, professional approach.

· Complete post\-event reports and communicate operational updates to office leadership.

Team Leadership \& Operations

· Recruit, interview, and assist with hiring event staff.

· Assist with employee scheduling and workforce planning.

· Review employee PERC Card certifications and required compliance documentation.

· Coach and mentor employees.

· Summarize payroll following events and work with accounting to resolve payroll questions.

· Assist with client meetings and help build long\-term client relationships.

What We're Looking For

· Previous management or supervisory experience required.

· Experience in event operations, hospitality, security, customer service, or a related field preferred.

· Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.

· Strong organizational and time management abilities.

· Ability to remain calm under pressure and make sound decisions.

· Comfortable supervising large teams.

· Proficient in Microsoft Outlook, Excel, and Word.

· Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.

Schedule

This is a full\-time, salaried position with a schedule driven by the event calendar \- not a traditional Monday\-through\-Friday, 9\-to\-5 schedule. Hours fluctuate significantly, but primarily 2nd shift: lighter weeks may require approximately 30 hours, while busy event weeks may require 50 or more hours. The role regularly includes early mornings, evenings, weekends, and occasional holidays, and some busy periods may involve working portions of several consecutive days. In return, the position offers flexibility during slower periods and between event responsibilities, provided office duties are completed and assigned events are fully supported.

· Combination of office work in Oak Brook and onsite event management throughout the Chicagoland area.

Physical Requirements

· Ability to stand and walk for extended periods during events.

· Ability to navigate large convention centers and event venues.

· Ability to occasionally climb stairs and work indoors and outdoors as needed.

Benefits

· Competitive salary: $50,000\-$60,000 annually

· Health insurance

· Paid time off

· Illinois Secure Choice retirement program

· Professional development and leadership growth opportunities

· Opportunity to work at premier convention and event venues

Why AF Services?

At AF Services, you'll be trusted to make decisions, lead people, and represent our company with some of the region's most recognizable clients. We believe in promoting from within and investing in our people. High\-performing managers have opportunities to advance into senior operations leadership roles as our company continues to grow.

If you're looking for a career where every day is different, your leadership matters, and your work directly contributes to the success of major events across Chicagoland, we encourage you to apply.

Pay: $50,000\.00 \- $60,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

The Account Manager serves as the single point of ownership for an assigned portfolio of existing commercial HVAC customers, with full accountability for retention, growth, and overall customer satisfaction. This role manages the complete customer experience—from service contract renewals and capital project sales to coordinating service delivery and resolving operational issues. The Account Manager acts as both trusted business advisor and internal advocate, ensuring seamless coordination between sales, service operations, and project execution teams. Success requires balancing revenue growth objectives with operational excellence and customer satisfaction. This role focuses exclusively on existing customer relationships; new customer acquisition is handled by a separate Business Development team.

* Innovation

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


This team is focused on increasing adoption of Amazon Web Services by developing strategic accounts within the Fortune 1000\. This role calls for someone with business savvy and the technical background to help establish Amazon as a key technology platform provider. The ideal candidate brings a genuine passion for the intersection of Travel \& Hospitality with Technology.  

  

As an Enterprise Account Manager, you will have the exciting opportunity to help drive the growth and shape the future of an emerging technology. Your responsibilities will include driving revenue, adoption, and market penetration in enterprise accounts. We're looking for someone who possesses both a sales and technical background that enables them to drive engagement at the CXO level as well as with software developers and IT architects. The right person for this role is a self\-starter who is prepared to develop and execute against a territory coverage plan and consistently deliver on quarterly revenue targets.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Serve as a member of a three (3\) seller team structure, with one Principal Account Manager account lead, one Senior Account Manager, and one Account Manager
* Drive revenue and market share in a defined territory or industry vertical
* Meet or exceed quarterly revenue targets
* Develop and execute against a comprehensive account/territory plan
* Create \& articulate compelling value propositions around AWS services
* Accelerate customer adoption
* Maintain a robust sales pipeline
* Work with partners to extend reach \& drive adoption
* Manage contract negotiations
* Develop long\-term strategic relationships with key accounts
* Have responsibility for a specific portion of the customers portfolio, workloads, and projects
* Ensure customer satisfaction
* Expect moderate travel

  

A day in the life  

* Operate as a collaborative team member in a multi\-seller cross\-functional team
* Set the standard for account management practices
* Provide input into the creation of team goals
* Proactively identify and mitigate risks to one team strategy and outcomes
* Communicate effectively and collaboratively as part of multi\-seller team with up to 20 matrixed team members

  

  

  

About the team  

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all  

sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by  

providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and unwavering support. We dive deep  

to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that  

accelerate their success. This customer\-first approach is how we built the world's most  

adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

jobs.description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

**JOB OVERVIEW**  

  

This highly visible position will work closely with Client Management and key operational areas and is responsible for 100% client retention. The Account Manager will build and manage relationships acting as the conduit and advocate executing transactions on behalf of our clients. As a key member of the client facing team, the Account Manager will participate in defining, executing, and initiating activities across the organization to assure an exceptional client experience. This position will be responsible for the day\-to\-day activity of a diverse portfolio of clients. This individual will work with employees, leaders, customers, and suppliers at all levels of the organization on a regular basis. They will participate in Client meetings, planning, and leading action register initiatives and projects. This position requires an individual to be self\-motivated, results oriented, energizing, and able to engage in many different activities and projects at the same time. Success depends on building relationships with internal and external stakeholders, while exercising initiative and flexibility. The Account Manager must be able to work in a dynamic, fast paced environment with minimal supervision and prioritization of work, while providing exceptional customer service. From time to time the Account Manager will be asked to participate in meetings, industry events, special projects, and other strategic or tactical activities deemed important by leadership. Your ability to deliver and execute will help ensure perpetual retention of our clients. Effective management of day\-to\-day responsibilities and proper planning and execution ultimately supports our partners in achieving their fleet and business\-related objectives.  

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES \- ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* Manage a diverse portfolio of Clients
* Process, oversee and seek resolution on all Client operational requests
* Set up, facilitate Client Action register calls, and ensure items are progressing to completion
* Establish yourself as a knowledgeable resource in products, services, and communications to our clients
* Coach Clients on best practices to ensure their fleet is optimally run
* Help Client set up essential reporting in Fleetview so that exceptions are managed timely
* Work as a team with the Fleet Consulting Manager and Client Services Manager, to maintain account communication and client expectations
* Communicate effectively with Account team members about issues/challenges associated with client relations
* Closely manage and nurture accounts to identify and eliminate risk of attrition
* Take ownership of customer issues until closure
* Identify, manage, and maintain cycle time commitments via multiple channels including Salesforce, email, and telecom
* Improve processes that benefit Clients and or increase Wheels efficiency
* Develop and maintain SOPs for custom and standard business processes pertaining to your client portfolio
* Manage key data files/reports/processes
* Support other group members and departments as appropriate in their efforts
* Act as a Client Services stakeholder in cross functional meetings and when aiding product/IT development
* Other duties as assigned
* QUALITY:
	+ Maintain quality standards and metrics
	+ Meet Salesforce KPIs as set forth by Client Services
	+ Maintain established performance guidelines
	+ Support organization mission and goals
	+ Pro\-actively recognize and resolve client issues and develop a communication strategy to affected parties

 **LEADERSHIP RESPONSIBILITIES**

* No direct management responsibilities, but will provide day\-to\-day guidance and feedback

 **COMPETENCIES \- SKILLS**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Intermediate Proficiency in Microsoft Excel
* Intermediate math skills to calculate interest, percentages, depreciation rates, and discounts
* Time management skills along with excellent attention to detail
* Diplomacy, tact, and grace under pressure when working through challenging and/or urgent customer issues
* Team player with strong collaborative skills
* Ability to be flexible and adapt quickly in a fast\-paced environment
* Energetic and pro\-active: a driven, self\-starter who can work independently and as part of a team
* Proven track record of professionalism in a dynamic work environment
* Ability to provide sound problem solving, analysis and critical thinking
* Ability to gather, analyze and organize complex data and draw appropriate conclusions
* Ability to apply tools to understand and improve business processes

**Position Summary:**


Provides accurate, responsive, and compliance\-focused support across HR operations and the employee lifecycle. The HR Operations Coordinator processes workforce transactions, responds to employee and leader inquiries, maintains HR records, supports reporting and audits, and coordinates cross\-functional activities involving Human Resources, HR Technology, Payroll, Benefits, Information Technology, Information Security, Legal, and Records Management. The role also supports regulatory remediation activities, including Matters Requiring Attention (MRAs), by helping maintain data inventories, execute approved employee\-data retention and deletion procedures, validate results, and preserve audit evidence.

**Responsibilities:**

* Processes and monitors employee lifecycle transactions, job and organizational changes, contingent worker updates, leaves, terminations, rescissions, and related employee data corrections in Workday and connected service channels.
* Reviews requests for completeness, required approvals, effective dates, supporting documentation, and alignment with established policies, procedures, and service expectations before processing or escalation.
* Responds to routine employee and leader questions through HRConnect, shared inboxes, and other approved support channels; document activity, route complex matters to the appropriate HR partner and follow through to resolution.
* Maintains accurate and confidential personnel records, transaction documentation, acknowledgments, and operational evidence in accordance with company retention, privacy, legal\-hold, and records\-management requirements.
* Supports standard and ad hoc HR reporting, transaction audits, data\-quality reviews, exception tracking, and reconciliations; identify discrepancies and coordinate timely corrections with HR Technology or the responsible business owner.
* Assists with recurring HR programs and operational activities, including performance and compensation cycles, workforce changes, policy acknowledgments, labor\-law posting administration, work authorization tracking, and special projects.
* Partners with HR Technology and IT to troubleshoot system or workflow issues, document defects, test approved changes, and confirm that employee lifecycle processes operate as intended across Workday and downstream systems.
* Prepares process documentation, job aids, control evidence, status updates, and supporting materials for internal audits, external audits, compliance reviews, and management reporting.
* Recommends practical improvements that strengthen accuracy, timeliness, controls, employee experience, and scalability across HR operational processes.
* Supports MRA\-related workstreams involving employee data classification, retention, disposition, deletion, de\-identification, and access controls under the direction of the designated business, application, data, or risk owner.
* Maintains current inventories of HR applications, employee\-data locations, system owners, downstream interfaces, retention requirements, legal hold exceptions, and approved deletion or de\-identification rules.
* Coordinates approved deletion exercises by compiling employee populations, validating exclusions, distributing identifiers only through approved secure methods, tracking completion by system owners, and escalating delays or exceptions.
* Validates that approved HR system purge activities complete successfully and coordinate downstream confirmation, reconciliation, and issue resolution without independently changing legal, retention, security, or data\-classification requirements.
* Collects and organizes evidence of execution, including approvals, population files, validation results, exception logs, system\-owner confirmations, and remediation artifacts, in the designated controlled repository.

  



**Requirements**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* One (1\) \+ years of HR operations, HR coordination, HRIS support, records administration, compliance support, or related experience preferred.
* Experience supporting audits, data\-governance activities, regulatory remediation, or controlled operational processes is preferred.
* Working knowledge of HR operations and employee lifecycle processes; familiarity with Workday or a comparable enterprise HRIS is preferred.
* This is a hybrid position based in Irvine, CA or Chandler, AZ \- requiring two days per week.

**Turn Recess Into Something Kids Look Forward To!** ⚽

Program Coordinator – Recess Coach

**Love working with kids? Enjoy sports, games, movement, and bringing positive energy wherever you go?**

ITAV is looking for energetic, dependable, and enthusiastic **Program Coordinators – Recess Coaches** to help us transform recess into a fun, safe, inclusive, and meaningful part of the school day.

This isn't a job where you simply stand on the sidelines and watch.

You'll be **leading games, getting kids moving, encouraging teamwork, helping students work through conflicts, building confidence, and creating the kind of recess experience students can't wait to be part of.**

If you love working with young people and believe play can be a powerful way to teach leadership, communication, teamwork, and confidence — **we want to meet you!**

Who We Are

**ITAV** is a sports\-based youth development organization that uses sports, fitness, structured play, and engaging activities to help young people build confidence, communication skills, leadership, accountability, and positive relationships.

We believe kids learn some of life's most important lessons while they're moving, playing, competing, communicating, and having fun.

What You'll Be Doing

As a **Program Coordinator – Recess Coach**, you'll help bring energy, structure, and FUN to the school day.

You'll:

* Lead fun, age\-appropriate sports, games, and movement activities.
* Get students excited about participating — including kids who may not usually join in.
* Encourage teamwork, communication, sportsmanship, and fair play.
* Help students build confidence and leadership skills through play.
* Help students work through disagreements and practice healthy conflict resolution.
* Create an environment where every child feels welcomed and included.
* Actively supervise students and keep activities safe, organized, and engaging.

* Territory Management
* Capital Equipment Sales

Overview:

Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity.  

  

With 5,400\+ employees and over 80,000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq\-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world\-class products and services to all types of investors.  

  

Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth.

 **Business Segment Overview:**

**Commercial**: With boots on the ground authenticity at the heart of everything we do, our comprehensive array of commercial products and services enable you to work directly with our clients, across hedging, risk management, execution and clearing, OTC products, commodity finance and more.

  



**Position purpose:** StoneX Commodity Solutions LLC is part of StoneX Group Inc., a global financial services network that connects clients to markets across commodities, risk management, and physical supply. Our SCS Specialty Coffee team provides green coffee sourcing, sales, trade execution, and risk\-management solutions to roasters, importers, and specialty coffee partners.

  

This is a dual\-focus position that blends front\-line customer relationship management with behind\-the\-scenes trade and operations support. The Customer Success Associate / Trade Assistant is the connective tissue of the desk — keeping customers informed and supported while ensuring trades, contracts, and logistics run smoothly from execution through delivery. It is an ideal opportunity for an organized, detail\-oriented professional who wants exposure to both the commercial and operational sides of the specialty coffee trade.

  

Reporting to the Senior Vice President, SCS Specialty Coffee, this role serves as a primary day\-to\-day contact for customers and as a core support resource for the sales and trading team. On the customer success side, you will own the post\-sale relationship — onboarding accounts, coordinating samples, communicating order and shipment status, and resolving issues. On the trade\-assistant side, you will support contract administration, position tracking, logistics coordination, and trade documentation. Success in this role means customers feel well cared for and the desk’s trades and records are accurate, timely, and audit\-ready.

 ***Note on role design:*** *This role is currently structured as a single, combined position covering both customer success and trade\-assistant responsibilities (approximately a 50/50 split). As the desk grows, the intent is to split it into two specialized roles. The successful candidate will help shape and document both functions in the interim.*

  


Responsibilities:
**Primary duties will include:** **Customer Success*** Serve as the primary day\-to\-day point of contact for assigned specialty green coffee customers.
* Onboard new accounts and maintain accurate, up\-to\-date customer records in the CRM.
* Coordinate coffee sample requests end to end — dispatch, tracking, and follow\-up on approvals.
* Proactively communicate order status, contract milestones, delivery timelines, and relevant market updates to customers.
* Respond to customer inquiries promptly, resolve issues, and escalate complex matters to the appropriate sales executive or trader.
* Support customer retention and, in partnership with the sales team, identify opportunities to grow existing accounts.
* Gather customer feedback and share insights with sales and trading to improve service and offerings.

**Trade Assistant*** Support traders and sales executives with trade execution, contract administration, and day\-to\-day desk operations.
* Draft, issue, and track purchase and sales contracts, verifying that terms, quantities, prices, and differentials are accurate.
* Maintain position records, reconcile them against executed trades, and support weekly position reporting.
* Coordinate logistics with operations — shipment bookings, shipping documents, inventory, and warehouse tracking.
* Liaise with operations, finance, and settlements on invoicing, payments, and trade documentation.
* Monitor contract execution milestones such as shipment, first\-notice/quality steps, grading, and arrival.
* Assist with futures and hedging administration and reconciliation under the supervision of the trading team.
* Maintain data integrity across trading, CRM, and reporting systems.

**Shared / General*** Partner across sales, trading, operations, and finance to keep information flowing and deadlines met.
* Help build and document repeatable processes as the desk scales and the role prepares to split into two functions.
* Prepare reports, trackers, and dashboards to support the team and leadership.


Qualifications:
**To land this role you will need:*** 1–3 years of experience in a customer\-facing, operations, administrative, or coordination role — relevant internship experience will also be considered.
* Strong organizational skills and a high level of attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines simultaneously.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and the broader Microsoft Office suite, and the ability to quickly learn CRM and trade/ERP systems.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and a genuine customer\-service orientation.
* Ability to work onsite at the Alpharetta, GA office and legal authorization to work in the United States.

**What makes you stand out:*** Prior experience in coffee, green coffee, or a related soft\-commodities, commodity\-trading, import, or logistics environment (preferred, not required).
* Direct experience with green coffee contracts, ICE Coffee “C” futures, or physical commodity trade operations.

**Sales Representative\- Schaumburg, IL\- Full Time** 

***Ideal role for someone looking to kick\-start their career in sales with structured training and coaching. 1\+ years of sales experience is preferred but not required.*** 

*The Experience:*

We're hiring someone to build a rewarding sales career with the training, coaching, and uncapped earning potential to back it up.

As a Sales Representative, you'll lead the entire customer journey. This is a full\-cycle role: you’ll manage inbound leads, diagnose exterior damage, educate homeowners, and guide them through everything from proposal to signed contract. Every deal you close is a deal you own and every referral and repeat customer you earn compounds into a book of business that's genuinely yours.

You'll work alongside Sales Management and Production, and you'll be backed by a company that is serious about investing in its people and committed to their long\-term success.

This is a field role. You'll spend your time inspecting roofs and siding, and meeting homeowners where they are (within Chicagoland area \- not storm chasing). You'll also spend regular time in the office for coaching, training, and team meetings.

*Training \& Career Growth:*

From day one, you're invested in through a structured development path designed to turn new reps into top performers.

* Initial onboarding: a structured start that gets you up to speed on our process, systems, and expectations before you're on your own
* Product training: deep, hands\-on knowledge of roofing, siding, windows, and gutters so you can speak to homeowners with real credibility
* Sales training: proven frameworks for objection handling, estimating, and closing, taught by people who've done the job
* Ride\-alongs: shadow experienced reps and get shadowed yourself, so feedback is built into the job
* Weekly coaching: regular one\-on\-one time with sales leadership focused on your pipeline, your numbers, and your growth
* Leadership development: a real path from rep to team lead to sales manager for those who want to grow beyond individual production

*What You'll Actually Be Doing:*

* Running company\-provided appointments sourced through marketing efforts
* Performing roof, siding, window, and gutter inspections to accurately assess damage and scope of work
* Educating homeowners on products, solutions, and the insurance claims process where applicable
* Preparing estimates and proposals, then negotiating and closing sales
* Following up with prospects to keep your pipeline moving
* Managing projects from signed contract through completion, delivering an exceptional customer experience at every step
* Building a base of referral and repeat business over time

*You're Our Person If:*

* You're comfortable initiating conversations and building trust with homeowners
* You have a strong work ethic and are self\-motivated
* You're coachable, curious, and eager to learn
* You thrive in a performance\-based environment
* You have strong organizational and time\-management skills
* You hold a valid driver's license and have reliable transportation

*Even Better If...*

* You have outside sales or in\-home sales experience
* You've worked in home improvement, construction, or insurance restoration
* You have knowledge of roofing, siding, windows, or gutters
* You've used a CRM before (AccuLynx or similar)

*Location \& Work Type:*

This role is based out of our office located in Schaumburg, Illinois, serving the surrounding Chicago northwest suburbs. It is a full\-time, field\-based position requiring regular travel throughout the service area to meet with homeowners, conduct inspections, and manage customer relationships, along with regular attendance at office meetings and training sessions.

*Compensation*:

$100,000\.00 \- $200,000\.00 per year (uncapped commissions)

**Salary \+ commission or full commission options!**

Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $200,000\.00 per year
